1.001.201 was a minor update released for Helldivers 2.

Contents

  • 1 概述
  • 2 平衡性调整
    • 2.1 战略配备
    • 2.2 主武器
  • 3 修复
    • 3.1 解决了最高优先级问题
    • 3.2 崩溃与软锁
    • 3.3 绝地潜兵修复
    • 3.4 武器与战略配备
    • 3.5 敌人
    • 3.6 任务与难度
    • 3.7 社交问题与银河战争地图
    • 3.8 杂项修复

概述

  • 平衡性调整
  • 修复
    • 解决了最高优先级问题
    • 崩溃与软锁
    • 绝地潜兵修复
    • 武器与战略配备
    • 敌人
    • 任务与难度
    • 社交问题与银河战争地图
    • 杂项修复

平衡性调整

战略配备

  • Shield Generator Relay
    • 持续时间从30秒增加到40秒

主武器

  • SG-8P Punisher Plasma
    • In response to popular Helldiver demand, General Brasch has issued an administrative order to revert the production changes made to the SG-8P Punisher Plasma (from Patch 01.001.104)
      • We have reverted the latest changes so the SG-8P Punisher Plasma will now have a more noticeable arc in its projectile path, starting off slower and maintaining speed longer. This will affect its recoil, fire rate, and projectile behavior
    • 为了进一步提升其效能，弹匣容量已从8发增加至10发

修复

解决了最高优先级问题

  • 修复了遭遇战无法结束，且敌人生成在任务剩余时间内被关闭的问题
  • Fixed a bug where the hive breaker drill would become inaccessible when called in
  • 修复了终端失去功能导致无法完成任务的问题
  • Dead bodies of Chargers no longer launch Helldivers into the air
  • 在呼叫战略配备时按下方向键下键不再会使用补给包
  • 游戏重启后，QWERTY键盘小键盘绑定现在可以正确保存
  • The Service Technician is no longer mourning the death of her beloved pet goldfish “Goldie” and can now be interacted with again. Goldie received a dignified funeral and was laid to rest gracefully in a waste capsule, ejected towards the nearest planets atmosphere where the friction between the air and the capsule caused it to heat up, violently explode, and disintegrate
  • 修复了问题，现在当4人小队中任意一名成员离开后，其他玩家可以通过Quickplay加入大厅
  • 修复了部分玩家的社交菜单卡在"请民主地等待"界面的问题
  • 好友的"仅限邀请"游戏不再显示在银河战争地图上，且无法加入
    • 修复了未受邀请的好友可以通过社交菜单加入"仅限邀请"游戏的问题
    • 仅限邀请的大厅不再显示在全息投影中

崩溃与软锁

  • Fixed a crash on Difficulty 1 (Trivial) when approaching certain bug holes
  • 修复了与小队一起放弃任务时与虫族战斗可能发生的软锁死问题
  • Fixed Geological Survey mission soft-locking when players joined/left the mission
  • 修复了如果在任务总结界面中途加入游戏且所有其他玩家离开时可能发生的软锁死问题
  • 修复了浏览军械库或战争债券商店时罕见的崩溃问题
  • 修复了雾被破坏时可能发生的崩溃
  • 修复了与火焰喷射器和毒气榴弹武器相关的罕见崩溃
  • Fixed a crash when repeatedly entering and leaving the tutorial
  • Fixed an issue where the Nuke Nursery could not be progressed if two players called down the drill at the same time
  • 修复了在表情动作轮盘激活时打开菜单会导致玩家无法移动的问题
  • 修复了"用核武器炸毁繁育窝"终端有时无法交互的问题

绝地潜兵修复

  • 修复了在不平整地形上飞扑或爬行时过度触发布娃娃效果的问题
    • 我们目前正在研究进一步的解决方案以解决布娃娃效果问题。

武器与战略配备

  • Fixed stim pistol incorrectly affecting the STIMS USED statistic in the mission end screen
  • Fixed dead corpses setting off the rockets from the RL-77 Airburst Rocket Launcher
  • Fixed an issue with the stratagem cooldown that allowed players to call down multiple resupplies or Hellbombs at the same time
  • Fixed an issue where switching to holding a grenade and picking up an artillery shell at the same time caused the artillery shell to become stuck in the Helldivers hands
  • The LAS-5 Scythe scope is now fully operational and can zoom in and out correctly
  • 空的可消耗武器无法再被拾取或收起
  • The AR-23A Liberator Carbine now has the 0.5 sec shorter reload duration properly implemented, from 3 to 2.5 sec. It also has the correct magazine unit
  • The MG-43 Machine Gun now has the 0.5 sec shorter reload duration properly implemented
    • 我们之前错误地写道MG-43机枪从4秒降低到了3.5秒，实际上是从5秒降低到了4.5秒
  • 修复了P-11治疗剂手枪注射器的缺失网格

敌人

  • Disabled the gas confusion effect on the Impaler due to odd behavior with its tentacles
  • 修复了穿刺虫的触手有时无法击中目标的问题
  • Adjusted Shriekers pathing in tight spaces. They should now prefer to move around tall obstacles instead of trying to fly over them

任务与难度

  • 修复了用核武器炸毁繁育窝钻机被放在虫尸上的问题
  • 降低了任务中针对机器人的Retrieve Data目标生成数量，以匹配针对终结族的生成数量
  • The Escape Pod objective will now appear on difficulties 1-2 instead of 2-3
  • The Terminid eggs on Purge Hatcheries objectives are now tagged as objectives with correct VO and icons
  • 修复了Nuke Nurseries任务中Hellpods在Bug Nurseries边缘深埋地下的问题

社交问题与银河战争地图

  • 修复了"已屏蔽玩家"标签页中的一个问题：尝试通过搜索功能添加玩家时会错误地显示该用户已被屏蔽
  • 无法再通过银河战争全息图加入已屏蔽玩家的游戏
  • 修复了已屏蔽玩家仍能在语音聊天中发言的问题
  • 修复了表情、放下和通讯轮盘的鼠标灵敏度未生效的问题
  • PC玩家现在可以使用左键点击来选择表情和通讯轮盘菜单中的选项
  • 修复了社交面板中显示的好友数量上限为100的问题
  • 修复了阻止好友请求组件弹出的问题
  • 修复了同时收到多个邀请时，会话邀请发送者名称显示不正确的问题
  • Emotes can no longer be triggered while airborne, ragdolling or sliding. We are monitoring this change and appreciate your feedback for it!
  • 修复了社交系统中的多个问题并提升了其可靠性

杂项修复

  • Added information in the loadout boosters menu screen showing which player has equipped what specific booster
  • 修复了未绑定的按键/按钮绑定会保持未绑定状态，而不会恢复为默认设置的问题
  • 修复了在社交菜单刷新期间加入时，玩家有时会加错好友的问题
  • 在浏览地图时禁用第三人称玩家摄像机
  • 降低了玩家客户端在使用Quickplay时尝试加入已满大厅的概率
  • Fixed an issue where the host's player Title was incorrectly assigned to Helldivers who joined their session
  • 修复了在任务期间于设置中更改耐力槽宽度时，其边框无法正确调整大小的问题
  • 修复了可携带物如果在同一帧内被拾取和放下，就无法再次拾取的问题
  • 修复了如果第一个战略配备已被选中则无法选择新的第一个战略配备的问题
  • 修复了绝地潜兵角色自定义设置在关闭游戏后重置的问题
  • 修复了某些亚洲语言字符在重要指令文本和简报中显示为问号的问题
  • 修复了打开举报弹窗时显示错误平台图标的问题
  • 修复了多行文本中缺失的"-"字符
  • 修复了在布娃娃状态下进入ADS（瞄准）时摄像机错位的问题
  • 在太空画质设为低时降低了行星分辨率，并新增了与之前低设置相匹配的中型太空画质选项
  • Light intensity slightly reduced during the Fire Tornado weather effect
  • Fixed an issue where the visual appearance of the Stratagem Hero minigame terminal's arrows lost their colors if a player moved too far away from the terminal
  • 修复了派遣内容有时对非拉丁语言字符显示为问号的问题
  • 修复了遭遇战在因达到特定生成上限而被禁用后仍会尝试生成的问题
  • 修复了滚动消息会移动镜头的问题
  • 修复了与强化资源描述相关的几个问题
  • 任务期间，行星现在会正确排序显示在极光等天空效果后方
  • 修复了崩溃报告器有时不会弹出的问题
  • General Brasch and Jane Helldiver to award Patriotic Medal for Excellence in Patriotism to the members of the Freedom Alliance. Due to budget cuts, these brave Helldivers will receive an extra 3 seconds of R&R which has now been used reading this note. Get back to work Helldivers
  • 其他性能优化
    • 立方体贴图、反射和渲染性能改进

1.001.104 was a major update released for Helldivers 2. It is the second half and conclusion of the 60 Day Timeline, whose first half was Patch 1.001.100.

平衡性调整

常规变更

额外补给物品现在会在小地图上显示。

  • 外骨骼机甲
  • 支援型战略配备

移除了轨道武器战略配备投射物、Eagle-1 炸弹和 FAF-14 飞矛导弹的跳弹效果。

  • 它们不再能从目标上弹开。

绝地潜兵护甲调整，重型和轻型护甲现在更加有效

重型护甲受到的伤害减少 25%，从 20% 上调。

  • 伤害减免提高5%

轻型护甲受到的伤害增加 25%，从 33% 下调。

  • 受到的伤害降低8%

战略配备与武器标签描述已更新，现在显示更多信息并进行分类。

  • 护甲穿透攻击 2 被归类为轻型护甲穿透
  • 护甲穿透攻击 3 被归类为中型护甲穿透
  • 护甲穿透攻击 4 被归类为重型护甲穿透
  • 护甲穿透攻击 5+ 被归类为反坦克。

主武器

Plasma projectile behavior

We’ve standardized the behavior of Plasma projectiles, which previously had varying characteristics in how they traveled through the air. Now, all Plasma projectiles experience high drag, causing them to slow down faster. However, each plasma weapon still fires projectiles at different speeds and calibers, so their effective ranges will remain distinct. For most weapons, this change won’t be very noticeable. With the SG-8P Punisher Plasma you’ll see a less pronounced arc in its projectile path. Instead, it will start off faster and lose speed more rapidly, keeping its effective range about the same.

PLAS-101 Purifier

  • 投射物现在可以充能，并带有按比例提升的伤害倍率
    • 最低充能 0.1 秒可获得 50% 伤害倍率
    • 最高充能 1 秒可获得 100% 伤害倍率
  • Maximum charge projectile damage从100提升至200
  • Maximum charge projectile durable damage从50提升至100
  • Maximum charge explosion damage从150提升至300
  • 爆炸伤害不随充能变化，但完全充能的射击具有不同的爆炸效果：
  • 最低充能（0.1–0.99秒）：内半径1米，外半径2米，爆炸伤害75。
  • 最高充能（1秒）：内半径2.9米，外半径3米，爆炸伤害300。

PLAS-1 Scorcher

  • 新武器功能：自动开火模式。
  • 射速从250提升至350
  • 弹匣容量从15提升至20
  • 备用弹匣从6减少至5

SG-8P Punisher Plasma

  • 降低后坐力
  • 射速从80提升至100

AR-23 Liberator

  • 水平后坐力降低30%。

AR-23P Liberator Penetrator

  • 水平后坐力降低30%。
  • 弹匣容量从 30 提升至 45。
  • 备用弹匣从10减少至7

AR-23A Liberator Carbine

  • 水平后坐力降低30%。
  • 人体工学从65提升至70
  • 装填时间从3秒缩短至2.5秒

BR-14 Adjudicator

  • 水平后坐力降低30%。
  • 投射物伤害从80提升至90
  • 投射物耐久伤害从16提升至23
  • 弹匣容量从25提升至30

AR-61 Tenderizer

  • 新武器功能：600/850 转速。

JAR-5 Dominator

  • 从炸弹武器类别移至特殊武器类别

Sidearms

P-113 Verdict

  • 护甲穿透从2提升至3
  • 投射物耐久伤害从13提升至32
  • 踉跄值从13提升至15

P-4 Senator

  • 护甲穿透从3提升至4
  • 投射物伤害从175提升至200
  • 投射物耐久伤害从35提升至70

P-11 Stim Pistol

  • 散布从30降低至5
  • 弹速从80提升至200

投掷物

K-2 Throwing Knives

  • 使用次数从8提升至20

G-12 High Explosive Grenade

  • 伤害从400提升至800

G-6 Frag Grenade

  • 伤害从250提升至500

G-10 Incendiary Grenade

  • 伤害从150提升至300

战略配备支援武器

AC-8 Autocannon

  • 新增武器功能：智能弹药现在允许你在普通投射物与高射炮弹之间切换。
  • 高射炮弹为近炸触发的破片爆炸，拥有更大的爆炸半径。

GR-8 Recoilless Rifle

  • 新增武器功能：智能弹药现在允许你在普通投射物与高爆弹药之间切换。
  • 高爆弹药拥有更大的爆炸半径，造成更多爆炸伤害，但投射伤害更低，且对坦克的效果较差。

RL-77 Airburst Rocket Launcher

  • 装填时间从7秒缩短至5秒

M-105 LMG Stalwart

  • 人体工学从25提升至40

MG-43 Machine Gun

  • 弹匣容量从150提升至175
  • Starting spare magazines从1提升至2

MG-206 Heavy Machine Gun

  • 弹匣容量从75提升至100

背包

LIFT-850 Jump Pack

  • 冷却时间从20秒缩短至15秒
  • 更强的推力
  • Thrust vector has been tweaked. 跳跃高度会略高，前进动量更大

AX/AR-23 “Guard Dog”

  • AR-23 解放者弹药替换为 AR-23P 穿甲“解放者”弹药。
  • 护甲穿透从2提升至3
  • 伤害从70降低至60
  • 弹匣容量从30提升至45

Drone Backpacks now has a new toggle drone function

  • 激活：无人机离开背包并开始执行任务
  • 停用：无人机返回背包并进入被动待机状态。

战略配备

Eagle Strafing Run

  • 爆炸半径略微增加
  • 爆炸伤害从250提升至350

Orbital Airburst Strike

  • 齐射次数从3提升至4
  • Duration between salvoes从3提升至4

A/MG-43 Machine Gun Sentry

  • 弹匣容量从125提升至175
  • 冷却时间从120秒缩短至90秒
  • 持续时间从180秒缩短至150秒

A/G-16 Gatling Sentry

  • 弹匣容量从400提升至500
  • 冷却时间从180秒缩短至150秒
  • 持续时间从180秒缩短至150秒

A/MLS-4X Rocket Sentry

  • 冷却时间从180秒缩短至150秒
  • 持续时间从180秒缩短至150秒

A/AC-8 Autocannon Sentry

  • 冷却时间从180秒缩短至150秒
  • 持续时间从180秒缩短至150秒

A/AC-8 Autocannon Sentry

  • 冷却时间从180秒缩短至150秒
  • 持续时间从180秒缩短至150秒

MD-17 Anti Tank Mines

We are working on changes to the Anti-Personnel and Incendiary Mines; however, we are not yet satisfied with the fixes, as we feel they introduced too many new problems. We will continue working on these changes and include them in a future patch.

The mines are now only triggered by heavier enemies like Chargers, Bile Titans, Impalers, and Hulks

  • 伤害从800提升至2000
  • 爆炸半径减小

A/ARC-3 Tesla Tower

  • 充能射击的冷却时间从 3 秒减少至 1 秒。
  • 冷却时间从150秒缩短至120秒
  • 持续时间从180秒缩短至150秒

FX-12 Shield Generator Relay

  • 移除了受到伤害之间的充能延迟。
  • 充能速率从 300 提升至 400 生命值/秒。
  • 半径从8米提升至15米
  • 一旦盾雷失效，它将不再恢复。

玩法

Patrol Spawning

Previously, once the mission was completed but before extraction, we significantly increased patrol spawns across the entire map. Now, the increased patrol spawns are concentrated around the extraction site, with more patrols appearing the closer you are to it. This change should make patrol spawning feel more logical and reduce the penalty for players who complete the mission but still want to explore the map or collect samples. Please let us know if you still experience issues with patrol spawning!

终结族

Bile Spewers

  • 腿部生命值从300降低至200

Nursing Spewers

  • 腿部生命值从300降低至200

Hunters

  • 它们的扑击能力具有短暂的共享区域冷却时间
  • 现在在受到足够伤害时可以完全爆炸。

Scavengers

  • 在受到足够伤害时可以爆炸。

机器人

Automaton Targeting

  • 部分敌人无需获得正确视线就能向你射击，这导致它们会朝墙内或穿墙开火，即使你在隐藏状态下也能追踪你，并无视烟雾弹效果。 We've addressed these issues, so now you should be able to use stealth more effectively against the Automatons, and they won’t be able to shoot through walls or see you when they shouldn’t. Please let us know if you still encounter issues like these!

机器人投射物

Normal small projectiles damage reduced from 40 to 35 (used by enemies like the Devastators, Emplacements, and Conscripts)

  • 重型投射物伤害从65降低至60（由重型炮台和侦察纵步者等敌人使用）。

Hulk Bruiser

In response to their disapproval of a newly installed cannon on the Automaton Hulk Bruisers, Super Earth High Command sent a crack commando to sabotage their production facilities. The skilled operative promptly escaped into the shadows after completing their mission. Today, still wanted by the Automatons, they survive as a soldier of fortune. If you have a problem, if no one else can help, and if you can find them, maybe you can enlist… John Helldiver. As a result, the Automatons had to revert back to using rocket launchers for their Hulk Bruisers.

All Devastators

  • 头部护甲从2降低至1
  • 头部生命值从100提升至110

Berserkers

  • 头部生命值从125降低至110

Heavy Devastator

  • 它们齐射之间的间隔略微增加，为绝地潜兵提供了更好的反击机会。

All Tanks

  • Front armor reduced from 6 to 5. Our previous tweak didn't have the intended effect on gameplay that we expected, so we’ve reverted this back.
  • The rear weak spots of the Tank's body now have their own health pool, which matches the Tank's previous total health. Once this health pool is depleted, the Tank will be destroyed. Additionally, these weak spots also deal 150% damage to the Tank's main health.

Annihilator Tank Turrets & Shredder Tank Turrets

  • The rear weak spots of the Tank's body now have their own health pool, which matches the Tank's previous total health. Once this health pool is depleted, the Tank will be destroyed. Additionally, these weak spots also deal 200% damage to the Tank's main health.

Barrager Tank Turret

  • 如果坦克主体被摧毁，炮塔现在也会被摧毁。

修复

已解决最高优先级问题。

  • Not enough enemies spawn to complete Eradicate missions
  • 部分敌人无需获得正确视线就能向你射击，这导致它们会朝墙内或穿墙开火，即使你在隐藏状态下也能追踪你，并无视烟雾弹效果。
  • 巡逻敌人的生成现在应该更加合理，并降低对已完成任务但仍想探索地图或收集样本的玩家的惩罚。

崩溃修复与软锁

  • Fixed crash that could occur when getting knocked back while wearing the energy shield backpack.
  • 修复了当同伴带着独特护甲自定义离开时可能发生的崩溃。
  • 多种崩溃修复

杂项修复

  • 修复了穿戴重型护甲的绝地潜兵对毒气状态效果免疫的漏洞。
  • General Brasch returns from holiday retreat in foggy hillside town.

已知问题

这些问题要么是由本次补丁引入的且正在修复中，要么来自之前的版本且尚未修复。

最高优先级

  • “虫窝破裂者”钻机在呼叫时可能无法访问。
  • 玩家可能无法收到来自其他平台的好友申请。
  • 终端可能会失去功能，导致任务无法完成。
  • 部分玩家的社交菜单卡在“请民主地等待”界面。
  • Title 可能会在开场动画或标题画面时崩溃。
  • 好友的“仅邀请”游戏仍可在银河战争地图上看到，但无法加入。

中等优先级

  • 玩家在使用喷气背包空中飞行时无法正常射击。
  • 战略配备球体在悬崖和某些地点会不可预测地弹跳。
  • 部分飞鹰战略配备在沼泽行星上部署时可能不会放下。
  • 增援可能对加入进行中的游戏的玩家不可用。
  • Pelican-1 被穿刺虫触手击中时有时可能会被击飞。
  • 如果在呼叫战略配备时按下控制器方向下键，补给背包可能会被错误地使用。
  • 高伤害武器不会引爆地图上已存在的地狱炸弹。
  • 部分流血致死的敌人不计入个人指令和歼灭任务的进度。
  • QWERTY键盘的小键盘按键绑定在重启游戏后无法正确保存。

未记录变更

This list is not exhaustive. 
If you find something that is undocumented and you can confirm it (or is confirmed by being on the page's change history), feel free to add it here.

武器

  • PLAS-101 净化者
    • 质量从100克减少至25克
    • 阻力系数从 100% 提升至 150%。
  • PLAS-1 灼烧者
    • 质量从100克减少至25克
    • 阻力从 100% 提升至 150%。

战略配备

  • RL-77 空爆火箭弹发射器。
  • Bomblet explosion damage从250提升至500.
    • 这是由于与 G-6 破片手雷共享伤害 ID。
  • 轨道加特林弹幕
    • 爆炸伤害从250提升至350
  • 超级地球武装力量火炮
    • 投射伤害提升。
      • 投射物伤害从450提升至3500
      • 投射物耐久伤害从450提升至3500
    • 高爆弹药；爆炸伤害从 1200 提升至 1500

敌人

  • 湮灭坦克
    • 坦克车体爆炸伤害抵抗强度从 50% 降低至 35%
  • 铁幕坦克
    • 坦克车体正面爆炸抵抗强度从 50% 降低至 35%
  • 加农炮炮塔
    • Front armor reduced from  Tank II to  Tank I
      • 我们先前的微调未对游戏玩法产生预期效果，因此已将其回调。
    • 通风口设置为对主体 200%，750 生命值，致命弱点。
    • 正面护甲爆炸伤害抵抗强度从 100% 降低至 0%
  • 碎裂坦克
    • 坦克车体正面爆炸抵抗强度从 50% 降低至 35%

1.001.103 was a hotfix update released for Helldivers 2.


Contents

修复

崩溃修复

  • 修复了由独特的治疗剂手枪拥有者离开游戏引起的崩溃
  • 修复了新账户装备任何已购买的绝地喷射舱皮肤时发生的崩溃

杂项修复

  • 修复了身穿重型装甲的绝地潜兵对毒气榴弹状态效果免疫的漏洞
  • 不再能同时呼叫多个地震探测器和勘探钻机
  • 在撤离高价值色值目标任务期间，机器人不会像之前那样频繁地卡在朝墙壁射击的状态
  • The audio for all Bug and Bot enemies has been cleaned up and re-balanced recently. The focus has mostly been on their voices, but the movement has been looked at as well. The goal was to make enemy audio more balanced between each enemy type and to make enemies more audible in various situations. It will be subjective but please keep on the lookout for moments where you think the audio should have informed you about the enemy's presence but didn't
  • 已实施布拉施将军签发的侏儒河马保护令（莫登协议）

1.001.102 was a hotfix update released for Helldivers 2.


Contents

  • 1 概述
  • 2 修复
    • 2.1 崩溃修复
    • 2.2 杂项修复
  • 3 已知问题
    • 3.1 最高优先级
    • 3.2 中等优先级

概述

  • 崩溃修复
  • 盾雷背包修复
  • 其他修复

修复

崩溃修复

  • 修复了由武器装填引起的罕见崩溃
  • 修复了任务中打开聊天时罕见的崩溃。
  • 解决了与小队菜单相关的崩溃。
  • 修复了如果在虫族突破期间发生主机迁移可能导致的崩溃。
  • 修复了在他人舰船上同时打开军械库或舰船管理与采购菜单时的崩溃问题。
  • 修复了同时存在超过3名队友时发生的UI崩溃。
  • Fixed a crash which occurred after an early host migration and the former host having an unique skin in their hellpod.
  • 修复了同伴离开四人游戏时可能发生的崩溃。

杂项修复

  • The SH-32 Shield Generator Pack now properly transfers knockback to the wielder.
  • Fixed Helldiver cardboard not spawning in the tutorial.
  • 修复了绝地潜兵快速两次拾取同类型武器时手臂出现错误的错误。
  • 修复了购买战略配备时所有类别已拥有战略配备数量增加的问题。
  • Fixed issue with overlapping input for Rock Paper Scissor first option on the controller.
  • Fixed the Expert Exterminator title being incorrectly available to some players.
  • Fixed the issue where all the medals of a Warbond page would hide when scrolling.
  • Scout walkers will now receive the gas confusion effect when damaged by gas. 受到火焰喷射或毒气武器伤害时，它们也会正确地在生命区域受到伤害。
  • 修复了主机迁移时客户端不再显示新主机名称的问题。
  • Fix backpack being hidden while in the HMG Emplacement.
  • 解决了PS5玩家主机从休眠模式恢复后无法被加入的问题。
  • Fixed issue where a poor connection between a joining player and an existing player could cause the existing player to be disconnected from the session. For good measure, we also doubled the threshold for what is considered a poor connection. This should result in less instances of being randomly sent back to your ship without warning or reason.
  • 修复了阻止战略配备目标完成的主机迁移问题。
  • 修复了有时前置目标会显示在HUD主目标上方的错误。
  • 修复了穿刺虫收回触手时将玩家抛向空中的问题。
  • Fixed bug in "EVACUATE HIGH-VALUE ASSETS" where enemies would stop spawning for a period of time when the host leaves.
  • All Automaton Hulk types will now prioritize the player over the Power Generator in the Evacuate High-Value Assets mission.
  • Fixed broken menus when opening the main menu right before entering the hellpod (when the Loadout menu opens).
  • General Brasch was promoted to Super 10-Star General after the latest personal shield generator confusion.

已知问题

These are the highest priority issues that were either introduced by this patch and are being worked on, or are from a previous version and have not yet been fixed. This is not a comprehensive list.

最高优先级

  • 玩家可能收不到来自其他平台的好友申请
  • 在"营救高价值资产"任务中，敌人会尝试隔着墙壁射击发电机
  • 敌人有时能够穿墙射击
  • 部分玩家的社交菜单卡在'请民主地等待
  • 冲锋虫的尸体可以将绝地潜兵发射到空中

中等优先级

  • 加入进行中的游戏的玩家可能无法使用增援
  • Pelican-1 在被穿刺虫触手击中时有时可能会被击飞
  • 如果在呼叫战略配备时按下手柄的下方向键，补给包可能会被错误地使用
  • 好友的"仅邀请"游戏仍然可以在银河战争地图上显示，但无法加入
  • 高伤害武器不会引爆hellbombs
  • 一些流血死亡的敌人不会推进个人指令和歼灭任务

Contents

概述

  • Fix for SH-32 Shield Generator Pack
  • 崩溃修复

修复

  • 修复了新玩家加入时主机迁移期间的崩溃问题。
  • Helldivers were accidentally granted the SH-32 Shield Generator Packs from General Brasch´s personal stash. These are reserved for 10 star generals only. The workers at the distribution center have been sent to re-education camps and regular shields will resume distribution.
    • （此前它使绝地潜兵免疫近战伤害）

已知问题

These are the highest priority issues that were either introduced by this patch and are being worked on, or are from a previous version and have not yet been fixed. This is not a comprehensive list.

最高优先级

  • 玩家可能收不到来自其他平台的好友申请
  • 大型单位没有音频提示，使它们能够悄悄接近玩家
  • 在"营救高价值资产"任务中，敌人会尝试隔着墙壁射击发电机
  • 敌人有时能够穿墙射击
  • 部分玩家的社交菜单卡在'请民主地等待
  • 冲锋虫的尸体可以将绝地潜兵发射到空中
  • 战略配备球在悬崖和某些地点上弹跳不可预测
  • 玩家有时可能无法加入特定好友，或在加入后被送回舰船

  • 好友的"仅邀请"游戏仍然可以在银河战争地图上显示，但无法加入
  • 高伤害武器不会引爆hellbombs
  • 一些流血死亡的敌人不会推进个人指令和歼灭任务

概述

  • 反坦克、护甲穿透、生命值与护甲数值的重大调整
  • 武器与战略配备平衡性调整
  • 敌人重做
  • 绝地潜兵生命值与伤害机制调整

  • 新银河战争功能
  • 表情轮盘功能
  • 崩溃与漏洞修复

重大更新

绝地潜兵, Thank you for your valuable feedback. Many players have expressed feeling constrained in how they approach challenges, often relying on a limited set of tools while other options seem less effective. This has impacted your ability to play the game in a way that suits your preferences. So, what’s changing? For all the bugdivers out there, many situations were previously either resolved with your primary weapon or anti-tank weapons, which haven’t always performed as expected. With the overwhelming presence of Bile Titans and Chargers, many weapon choices therefore became invalid. To address this, we've reworked armor penetration, anti-tank weapons, enemy armor and health values. Our goal is to improve the effectiveness of weapons such as the Autocannon, Heavy Machine Gun, Flamethrower, and Anti-Materiel Rifle against heavily armored enemies. Although they may not be as effective as specialized anti-tank weapons, they are now more viable choices making your loadouts more versatile, fostering better team collaboration and planning. On the Bot front, Hulks have also had their armor reduced, making them more vulnerable to a wider range of weapons. Additionally, to improve the gameplay experience, the Devastator and Gunship will now have a limited supply of rockets, and those rockets won’t hit as frequently as before. This comes alongside the previously updated smaller impact radius for rockets, reducing excessive ragdolling. We’ve also made improvements to many primary weapons, bringing them closer in effectiveness to the most popular choices. This should offer more variety and flavor during your play sessions. We are adjusting damage mechanics to make the damage Helldivers receive more consistent over time by reducing 100% extra headshot damage to 50%. To maintain the overall challenge of the game, we've slightly increased the damage taken to other parts of the body. Our intent is to preserve the intensity of the gameplay while minimizing frustrating situations where sudden headshots cause large damage spikes.

With these changes, along with an upgraded Helldiver arsenal, enemy adjustments, and more consistent damage, the overall difficulty may slightly decrease. We'll be monitoring this closely and will listen to the community on how you think it feels.

We want to assure you that your feedback remains essential to us. Please share your thoughts on these updates, as we are actively listening. We plan to conduct another balance pass by Day 60 of our commitment to ensure we’re aligning with what you need for the best possible experience and to address any concerns or adjustments required. Your insights will be invaluable in refining these changes and making sure the game remains engaging and enjoyable for everyone.

平衡性调整

将军

  • Previously, partial damage dealt 50% of full damage, which we found to be overly punishing and reduced effectiveness too much, leading to an excessive reliance on high armor penetration weapons. We’ve now increased partial damage to 65% of full damage to address this issue.
  • The Helldiver now takes less damage from headshots, which previously dealt 100% extra damage but now inflict only 50% extra damage. Damage from hits to other body parts has been slightly increased depending on the area hit. This adjustment aims to normalize overall damage while maintaining detailed damage zones, reducing spike damage.

  • 这些武器通常分为三类：

行星与修正

  • Arid planets (similar to the Hellmire planet) will now only have the Intense Heat modifier active during fire tornado storms

  • 修复了在查看护甲/头盔/披风后，武装配置中的武器预览未能立即显示的问题
  • Fixed Eagle payloads sometimes not blowing up in swamp biome
  • 修复了要塞前哨站在任务总结目标界面显示（仅视觉上）0奖励的问题
  • 修复了超时玩家仍然以白色玩家颜色显示在UI上的问题
  • 修复了玩家长头衔名称文本现在会滚动而不是与其他文本重叠的问题
  • Fixed Reinforced Scout Strider showing the wrong name
  • Removed the deprecated Orbital Flare Stratagem from Stratagem hero
  • 修复了一些战略配备在武装配置中没有显示数据的问题
  • 修复了任务结束时呼叫增援和使用战略配备的数字显示问题
  • Fixed issue of drill objective floating in air when hot joining an ongoing 'Nuke Nursery' mission
  • 当玩家处于不同游戏版本时，禁用邀请/加入功能
  • 修复了任务结束后玩家名称不显示在舰船上的问题
  • Fixed a desync issue in how many civilians have been extracted in "Emergency Evacuation" mission
  • Fixed unexploded Hellbombs on the terrain not being pingable
  • 修复了中途加入任务时看不到队友装备的问题
  • 修复了在使用运输船撤离时错误显示"撤离失败"文本的问题
  • Solved the issue where the player will not unlock the new difficulties after fulfilling the requirements for it
  • 将战略配备输入绑定到其他按键不应再阻断终端输入
  • 修复了其他玩家的绝地潜兵在加入时，会在武装配置中玩家选择装备时显示在武器/护甲上方的问题
  • Fixed a bug when starting the mission even if exiting loadout. Going back to the briefing screen will now unready the player
  • 修复了玩家可以通过绑定菜单上的标签页点击条目的问题
  • 切换语言后，被标记的敌人和物体现在可以正确显示
  • 修复了战略配备购买取消体验中的问题，即向上移动鼠标并松开鼠标按钮不会停止按钮填充和购买流程。
  • 修复了布娃娃优化中的一个问题，某些物理actor使用了错误的碰撞过滤器，导致查询命中了非预期的形状
  • 修复了布娃娃优化代码中的一个bug，该bug导致某些爆炸类型造成不正确的伤害
  • 玩家信息弹窗中不再显示关于移除好友的错误信息
  • 修复了多行文本有时未对齐的问题
  • Fixed issue where it scrolled down/up 2 Warbonds in the Acquisitions menu when scrolling with the left controller stick
  • 修复了当"动态感测器启用模式"选项设置为"瞄准"时的瞄准动态控制问题，无论瞄准输入类型如何
  • 修复了玩家在更改飞船名称时可以切换标签页的漏洞
  • 修复了重新加入任务时没有播放最终就绪音效的问题
  • Map markers on objectives will follow the objective if it changes position, as in the case of SSSD drives
  • Fixed issue where the player can throw an unlimited amount of grenades/throwing knives after diving into shallow water while holding and then throwing the last throwable
  • 修复了另一个问题：如果玩家在上一个动作后直接打开战略配备菜单，可能会卡住一直拿着战略配备球
  • 现在当PlayFab登录失败时，游戏客户端会显示一条包含有用信息的恰当错误信息
  • 修复了 ADS 投射物错位问题
  • 修复了ADS中瞄准阻挡raycast的问题
  • 修复了由于反复进入和退出ADS而导致的瞄准位置错位问题
  • Fixed displayed incendiary mines icon and anti-tank mine label when the mine racks for these stratagems were marked/pinged
  • 修复了在军械库中切换标签页时滚动会清除滚动视图的问题
  • Fixed a bug that allowed players to bypass heat build-up for both the Scythe and Sickle when switching weapons during their reload animations
  • Fixed an issue where the 500kg bomb impact explosion was not being triggered
  • 修复了你可以在堡垒地点找到多个机密数据资产的问题
  • 增加了堡垒地点投放选择期间的红色区域大小
  • 改进了启动画面上的错误报告，以提供更好的支援
  • Enemies now spawn during "Spread Democracy" objectives
  • 为轨道武器火炮添加了另一种视觉效果
  • 修复了机器人投射物穿模的问题
  • 修复了Combat Walker撞上大型建筑会将其摧毁的问题
  • Fixed some assets bouncing flamethrower flames back
  • 修复了带有自定义开火模式的武器播放错误SFX音效的问题
  • 修复了任务时间结束时着陆信标中不显示撤离计时器的问题
  • Fixed health not synced correctly after the duration of stim heal (especially in friendly fire situations)
  • 修复了切换武器时的音效中断问题
  • General Brasch's Democratic values increased by 1000%

已知问题

These are the highest priority issues that were either introduced by this patch and are being worked on, or are from a previous version and have not yet been fixed. This is not a comprehensive list.

最高优先级

  • 玩家可能收不到来自其他平台的好友申请
  • 大型单位没有音频提示，使它们能够悄悄接近玩家
  • 在"营救高价值资产"任务中，敌人会尝试隔着墙壁射击发电机
  • 敌人有时能够穿墙射击
  • 部分玩家的社交菜单卡在'请民主地等待
  • 冲锋虫的尸体可以将绝地潜兵发射到空中
  • 战略配备球在悬崖和某些地点上弹跳不可预测
  • 玩家有时可能无法加入特定好友，或在加入后被送回舰船

中等优先级

  • 加入进行中的游戏的玩家可能无法使用增援
  • 地雷可能在多人联机大厅中变为隐形或消失
  • Pelican-1 在被穿刺虫触手击中时有时可能会被击飞
  • 如果在呼叫战略配备时按下手柄的下方向键，补给包可能会被错误地使用
  • 好友的"仅邀请"游戏仍然可以在银河战争地图上显示，但无法加入
  • 高伤害武器不会引爆hellbombs
  • 一些流血死亡的敌人不会推进个人指令和歼灭任务

未记录变更

Liberator Penetrator:

  • 踉跄值从15降低至10.

1.001.005 was a hotfix update released for Helldivers 2.

Contents

  • 1 补丁 01.001.005
    • 1.1 Fix
    • 1.2 已知问题（与上一份清单一致）

补丁 01.001.005

Fix

This patch is an emergency hot fix addressing the Impaler crash. We deemed it worth bringing this one crash fix in now in an attempt to minimize the crashes during the weekend. Thank you for your understanding.

  • 修复了在要塞内击杀穿刺虫时发生的常见崩溃问题。

已知问题（与上一份清单一致）

  • 玩家可能无法收到来自其他平台的好友申请。
  • 好友创建的"仅邀请"游戏仍可在银河战争地图上看到，但无法加入。
  • 开展地质调查"任务中，如果玩家呼叫"地震探测仪"后立即离开游戏或断开连接，任务可能无法完成。
  • 吐酸泰坦有时头部不会受到伤害。
  • 流血死亡的敌人不会推进个人指令和歼灭任务。
  • 大多数武器在瞄准时射击位置低于准星。
  • 铁丝网会阻挡火焰喷射器的火焰。
  • 战略配备光束可能会附着在敌人身上，但会部署到原始位置。
  • 护卫犬漫游者"在连续射击时不会过热。
  • 玩家现在可以拾取空的一次性武器，例如EAT-17或MLS-4X。
  • 增援可能对加入进行中的游戏的玩家不可用。
  • 舰船上的维修技术员无法互动。

补丁 01.001.004

概述

  • 崩溃修复
  • 武器和战略配备修复
  • 穿刺虫和爆炸半径的修复

修复

Crash fixes

  • 修复了在先前担任主机的情况下，通过邀请加入游戏时发生的崩溃问题。
  • 修复了因AFK被踢后发生的崩溃问题。
  • 修复了在降入任务时可能发生的崩溃问题。
  • 修复了在游戏启动期间关闭游戏可能发生的崩溃问题。

General Weapon and Stratagem fixes:

  • 修复了火焰喷射器粒子会无视敌人的问题。
  • 地雷现在可以在靠近危险物体时被射击并引爆。

Enemy fixes:

  • Reduced the explosion radius of Tentacles Stabbing ability and Light Rockets. This should alleviate the excessive ragdolling caused by the Impaler and Automaton enemies using light rockets. We are still working on improving the ragdoll behavior overall.
  • 修复了一个在某些情况下穿刺虫的触手会无限追击你的问题。

Miscellaneous fixes:

  • 修复了在主机离开后，加入游戏时可能导致软锁定的问题。

  • 吐酸泰坦有时头部不会受到伤害。
  • 流血死亡的敌人不会推进个人指令和歼灭任务。
  • 大多数武器在瞄准时射击位置低于准星。
  • 铁丝网会阻挡火焰喷射器的火焰。
  • 战略配备光束可能会附着在敌人身上，但会部署到原始位置。
  • 护卫犬漫游者"在连续射击时不会过热。
  • 玩家现在可以拾取空的一次性武器，例如EAT-17或MLS-4X。
  • 增援可能对加入进行中的游戏的玩家不可用。
  • 舰船上的维修技术员无法互动——他们抱怨被打扰太多，无法高效工作。

1.001.002 was a major update released for Helldivers 2, titled "Escalation of Freedom".


Contents

  • 1 概述
  • 2 补丁亮点
    • 2.1 难度等级10 - 超级绝地俯冲
    • 2.2 新增任务目标
    • 2.3 更大的敌方哨站
    • 2.4 新增虫族和机器人
    • 2.5 新沼泽星球
    • 2.6 新增环境危害
  • 3 平衡性调整
    • 3.1 主武器
    • 3.2 副武器
    • 3.3 战略配备
  • 4 玩法
  • 5 修复
    • 5.1 崩溃修复
    • 5.2 武器与战略配备修复
    • 5.3 社交菜单修复
    • 5.4 其他修复
  • 6 已知问题
  • 7 媒体

概述

The overview contains a broad cross section of what is fixed, addressed, and added in this patch. The highlights.

  • 难度等级10 - 超级绝地俯冲
  • 新增任务目标
  • 更大的敌方哨站
  • 新增虫族和机器人
  • 新增环境危害
  • 新增沼泽星球
  • 崩溃修复
  • Social menu fixes. We have fixed several issues and still have things to improve but know that we are aware and working tirelessly on this, we thank you for your patience and understanding.
  • 平衡性调整
  • 其他修复

补丁亮点

难度等级10 - 超级绝地俯冲

A new, extreme difficulty level designed for the most experienced and skilled Helldivers, featuring formidable new enemies and intense challenges.

新增任务目标

Two new secondary objectives will soon be active on a planet near you! These faction-specific optional objectives will have you assaulting Automaton human processing plants to destroy their evil Bio-Processor, and venturing deep into Terminid territory to extract with a living larva sample that the bugs will do anything to get back!

更大的敌方哨站

在新难度Super Helldive中特攻终结族据点和机器人堡垒。 The challenge will be great but the rewards even greater. Search the conquered outposts thoroughly for the confidential data and make sure to extract with it. May liberty guide your path.

新增虫族和机器人

新的、更强大的自由威胁正在浮现。 Guess who’s back to bug you again? The Impaler returns, burrowing its head and popping tentacles from the ground to catch you off guard. Watch out for its lethal limbs, but don’t miss its weak spot when it digs in - it seems like self-preservation still isn’t its strong suit! 然而，穿刺虫并非仅此而已。 Prepare for the rest of the formidable foes! The Rocket Tank rolls in with heavy armor and devastating firepower. The Reinforced Scout Strider now has its previously vulnerable spot fortified and boasts two rockets on each side for greater firepower! The Spore Charger fearlessly invades through the thick acidic fog, accompanied by an Alpha Commander, watch out for its friends!

新沼泽星球

Prepare to dive down into an eerie and foggy version of the swamp planet. Keep your wits about you and do not let fear take hold.

新增环境危害

Acid Storms - Temporarily lowers armor for enemies and the player. Make use of this but stay on high alert Helldivers.

平衡性调整

主武器

  • SG-8S Slugger
    • 增强了踉跄效果
    • 增加了散布
    • 增加了阻力
  • SG-225IE Breaker Incendiary
    • 弹匣数量从6个减少到4个
    • 后坐力从28增加到41
  • CB-9 Exploding Crossbow
    • 现为单手武器

副武器

  • GP-31 Grenade Pistol
    • 弹药容量从8减少到6
    • 将弹药箱补充的弹药数量从2发增加到4发

战略配备

  • AX/AR-23 Guard Dog
    • 弹匣数量从6个增加到8个
  • Orbital Walking Barrage
    • 齐射次数从3增加到5
    • 移速降低40%
  • Orbital 120mm HE Barrage
    • 冷却时间从240秒减少到180秒
    • 缩短了齐射间隔时间

玩法

  • The operation modifier Atmospheric Interference has been removed
    • Additionally for the automatons we added the modifier "Poor Intel" which makes objectives on the map to get a search radius just like most Eliminate objectives already has.
  • Corrosive acid planets no longer have the Intense Heat environment modifier.
  • 炮舰巡逻队现在出现频率降低，且舰船数量减少。
    • Gunship Engines are less durable now.
  • 改进了军械库武器预览的控制。
  • 更新了指令UI
  • Energy shields such as the SH-32 Shield Generator Pack and FX-12 Shield Generator Relay now block snowstorms as well as sandstorms.
  • A new grief protection system has been added that allows kicked players to continue in their own mission. This allows players to complete the mission and get full rewards despite being kicked.

修复

崩溃修复

  • Decreased the chance of crashing when pressing alt+tab while using exclusive fullscreen window mode. (Windows)
  • 修复了浏览战争债券时可能发生的罕见崩溃问题。
  • 修复了在武装配置中切换标签页时可能发生的罕见崩溃问题。
  • Fixed rare crash which could occur when inviting PSN friends to a session. (PS5)
  • 修复了在武装配置中选择强化资源时可能发生的罕见崩溃问题。
  • Fixed crash which could occur when browsing the acquisition center menus and alt-tabbing. (Windows)
  • 修复了加入游戏后在武装配置中可能发生的罕见崩溃问题。
  • 修复了布娃娃状态撞到铁丝网时可能发生的崩溃问题。
  • 修复了在加入任务时，因断开连接的玩家拥有激活的载具皮肤而可能发生的崩溃。
  • 修复了拥有独特皮肤的同伴被踢出或断开连接时可能发生的崩溃。

武器与战略配备修复

  • FS-55 Devastator Armor:
    • 修复了描述错误。
  • Blitzer:
    • 你现在可以按住开火按钮连续射击。
  • GP-31 Grenade Pistol, LAS-7 Dagger, SG-22 Bushwhacker:
    • 移入了特殊副武器类别。
  • ARC-12 Blitzer, Plasma Punisher:
    • 添加了缺失的护甲穿透标签。
  • LAS-16 Sickle:
    • 修复了武器属性中错误的射速数值。
  • SH-20 Ballistic Shield Backpack:
    • 不再阻挡敌人的视线。
    • 不再与战斗步行机发生碰撞。
    • 修复了拾取超级固态硬盘驱动器会导致防弹盾被放下的错误。
    • 修复了弹道盾牌在持握时不会与玩家碰撞的问题。
  • AX/AR-23 Guard Dog:
    • 现在可以从地图上找到的弹药箱中补充弹药。
  • 修复了在使用治疗剂治疗打断战略配备后，武器会被横向持握的错误。
  • Fixed arc weapons not shooting out any bolts when line of sight to enemy is blocked by an obstacle. Bolts will now fire but they will hit the obstacle. The misfires did not give the player sufficient feedback. We hope this makes the weapon operation clearer.
  • 修复了电弧武器在快速射击水平排列的敌人时发生哑火的问题。
  • Added in missing haptics when firing the AR-61 Tenderizer.

社交菜单修复

  • 社交菜单系统的总体改进。
  • 解决了一些与社交菜单选项不一致相关的问题。
  • 修复了小队菜单屏蔽按钮的相关问题。
  • 修复了社交菜单中的各种UI问题。
  • 屏蔽菜单"现在更准确地显示被屏蔽的玩家。
  • 改进了近期玩家标签页。
  • 提高了社交菜单选项的可靠性。
  • 解决了与好友代码生成相关的问题。
  • 减少了"请民主地等待"的出现频率。
  • 玩家应该能更轻松地加入彼此的游戏。
  • 玩家应该发现发送/接受/拒绝好友申请变得更加容易。
  • 改进了"危险"操作（踢出/屏蔽/解除好友）的用户体验。

其他修复

  • 修复了撤离运输船会沉入地下导致玩家无法撤离的游戏软锁定问题。
  • 修复了在设置和绑定菜单中能够点击隐藏项目（即已滚动出视野的项目）的问题。
  • 更改跨平台设置后退出游戏不再导致游戏卡住。
  • 修复了地狱舱在沼泽生态区不会摧毁树木的问题。
  • Weapons supporting auto reload retries could reload twice if interrupted in the final stage and firing occurred before resuming. Auto reload retries can now be canceled by pressing reload.
  • 解决了如果频繁触发，慢跑和冲刺动画的过渡会延迟的问题。
  • 降低了试验性注射剂强化资源的视觉效果强度。
  • 修复了试验性注射剂强化资源缺失描述的问题
  • 修复了绝地潜兵在瞄准状态下闪避后趴下旋转被重置的问题。
  • 修复了耐力槽不遵守耐力槽可视度HUD设置的问题。
  • 修复了购买后已拥有战略配备的章节编号不更新的问题。
  • 修复了全息地图预览不显示撤离点的问题。
  • 提高了地形破坏的性能。
  • 修复了由主机触发的过场动画中断后，绝地潜兵被困在冷冻舱中的问题。
  • 改进了防弹盾战略配备的物理效果，以及一些与物理相关的错误。
  • 修复了效果标签页顶部标题在葡萄牙语中显示不正确的问题。
  • 修复了在更改分辨率、渲染比例或屏幕设备后未应用时，切换设置菜单会导致放弃更改的问题。
  • 修复了拾取物品时玩家名称中的特殊字符不显示的问题。
  • 修复了玩家无法在弹出窗口中按ESC放弃分辨率更改的问题。
  • 修复了标记尖啸虫巢穴时显示为虫穴的问题。
  • 虫窝破裂者"钻机现在在"用核武器炸毁繁育腔室"任务中掉落时会造成伤害。
  • 修复了武器瞄准模式（包括全局和每武器设置）在关闭并重新打开游戏后无法记住的问题。
  • 修复了升旗目标不显示进度条的问题。
  • 调整了火焰效果，使其更加真实。
    • 它不会穿过各种躯体/物体，而反弹才是预期行为，例如在护甲和静态物体上。
  • 修复了小地图在离子风暴期间允许交互的问题。
  • 在游戏中更改文本语言将不再导致终端显示为空白。
  • 修复了从战争债券购买确认菜单装备皮肤时会重置玩家护甲选择的错误。
  • 绝地喷射舱皮肤现在可在舰船上显示；主机舰船的首次绝地喷射舱投放将使用主机选择的皮肤，而后续增援将使用个人皮肤选择。
  • 样本会在登机时转移到运输船上，在运输船内死亡不会掉落样本。
  • 在某一标签页恢复默认设置将不再覆盖其他标签页的设置。
  • 小地图现在会在退出外骨骼装甲时关闭（如果处于打开状态）。
  • 武装配置菜单中的呼叫时间现在包含运输时间，以与游戏内数值保持一致。
  • 地狱炸弹战略配备现在会在你靠近可呼叫它的目标点时显示在HUD上。
  • 已应用修复，避免多个战略配备——S.O.S.求救信标、哨兵、重新补给舱——部署在逃生舱内部。
  • 为Steam Deck添加了图形设置预设。
  • 绝地潜兵现在可以在满生命值时使用治疗剂以获得其其他民主效果。
  • 通过护卫犬击杀x名敌人"的个人指令现在可以完成。
  • 最新发布的战争债券现在将显示在战争债券列表的顶部。
  • 修复了刺杀任务中显示"[0/0]"的问题。
  • 修复了导致装备预览无限加载的bug。
  • 修复了队友拾取物品时未以其颜色显示名称的问题。
  • 修复了文字聊天光标无法工作的问题。
  • 实现了信息更丰富的快速游戏切换按钮。
  • 修复了效果选项卡有时显示乱码的问题。
  • 修复了中途加入的玩家看不到地雷的问题。
    • 此外，修复了导致最近部署的地雷变为不可见的错误。
  • 地雷若从外部被射击穿过防护罩生成中继器气泡，或位于固体障碍物后方被射击，将不再引爆。
  • 为所有武器显示命中标记。
  • 修复了玩家静音时不显示静音图标的问题。
  • 修复了使用治疗剂时取消其他玩家冲刺的错误。
  • 修复了手持一次性反坦克武器时的刺激动画。
  • Gone in 360 seconds奖杯现在在难度大于或等于6时均可获得，而非仅在难度6时获得。
  • 如果地狱炸弹在已武装且计时器激活时被摧毁，它将会爆炸。
  • 修复了玩家在从悬崖闪躲跳下时手持并扔出最后一件可投掷物后，可以无限投掷手雷/飞刀的问题。
    • 修复了另一个问题：玩家以同样方式落地后如果还有剩余手雷/飞刀，会手持一件隐形的手雷/飞刀。
  • 添加了"切换麦克风"选项，用于切换语音聊天的麦克风活动状态。
  • 哨兵炮塔现在不会尝试攻击某些建筑，并且子弹哨兵不会将弹药浪费在运输船上。
  • 修复了动态信息可视度设置无法正常工作的问题。
  • 修复了HUD战略配备可视度设置为隐藏时，打开地图仍会显示战略配备界面的问题。
  • 修复了UI有时显示已摧毁虫穴数量错误的问题。
  • 爱国者"外骨骼装甲的导弹不再造成自伤。
  • 修复了远距离爆炸对装甲敌人无效的问题。
  • 修复了在武装配置界面且队伍其他成员已在任务中时，无法进行文字聊天的问题。
  • 修复了任务控制无线电语音无法触发的问题。
  • 修复了更改配音语言可能需要很长时间（有时永久）才能应用的错误。
  • 修复了通过游戏内设置访问账户关联菜单时，若用户账户已关联则菜单会自动关闭的问题。
  • 保卫事件进度现在正确显示在任务结束序列中。
  • 修复了效果选项卡有时显示乱码的问题。

已知问题

这些问题要么是由本次补丁引入的且正在修复中，要么来自之前的版本且尚未修复。

  • 我们已知晓并正在调查难度10+的部分性能问题，我们已开始着手修复。
  • 如果玩家在部署过场动画期间断开连接，游戏可能会显示无限加载画面。
  • 玩家有时可能无法收到来自其他平台的好友申请。
  • 好友创建的"仅限邀请"游戏仍可在银河战争地图上看到，但无法加入。
  • 开展地质调查"任务中，如果玩家呼叫"地震探测仪"后立即离开游戏或断开连接，任务可能无法完成。
  • 吐酸泰坦有时头部不会受到伤害。
  • 流血死亡的敌人不会推进个人指令和歼灭任务。
  • 死亡的大型敌人有时可能会将绝地潜兵发射到空中。
  • 大多数武器在瞄准时射击位置低于准星。
  • 从防护罩生成中继器内部发射的火焰喷射器无法对敌人造成伤害。
  • 铁丝网会阻挡火焰喷射器的火焰。
  • 战略配备光束可能会附着在敌人身上，但会部署到原始位置。
  • 护卫犬漫游者"在连续射击时不会过热。
  • 增援可能对加入进行中的游戏的玩家不可用。
  • 舰船上的维修技术员无法互动——他们抱怨被打扰太多，无法高效工作。
  • 敌人有时可以穿透障碍物射击

1.000.405 was a hotfix update released for Helldivers 2.

Contents

  • 1 补丁 01.000.405

补丁 01.000.405

🌍 Overview

本次热修复旨在减少玩家卡在绝地喷射舱投放加载画面的情况。

🔧 Fixes

  • Reduced instances of being stuck waiting in infinite drop-in

🧠 Known Issues

  • 目前游戏内通过好友代码发送好友申请无法使用
  • 修复了弹道盾雷行为异常的各种问题。
  • 玩家可能无法被加入或邀请至游戏
  • 添加到近期玩家列表中的玩家将出现在列表中间
  • 玩家可能会遇到勋章和超级货币发放延迟
  • 流血致死的敌人不会推进个人指令和歼灭任务
  • 已部署的地雷有时可能会变得不可见（但仍然有效）
  • 电弧武器有时表现不一致，有时会哑火
  • 大多数武器在瞄准时射击点低于准星
  • 战略配备激光束可能会附着在敌人身上，但会部署到原始位置
  • 手推车站船模块不会减少Shield Generator Pack的冷却时间
  • 吐酸泰坦有时头部不会受到伤害
  • 加入进行中的游戏时玩家可能会卡在武装配置界面
  • 加入进行中的游戏的玩家可能无法使用增援
  • 每次保卫任务结束时行星解放战役进度达到100%
  • 升起超级地球旗帜目标不显示进度条
  • 职业标签页中的任务计数在每次重启游戏后重置为零
  • 部分武器的描述已过时，无法反映其当前设计
  • Personal orders may not display correctly. (Kill 5.)

补丁 01.000.404

🌍 Overview

This hotfix aims to resolve crashes and to reduce the number of people stuck in the hellpod drop-in loading screen. Tier 5 Ship Module Upgrades were released alongside this patch.

🔧 Fixes

  • Fixed the 'Superior Packing Methodology' ship module upgrade (technically this was fixed on the server side and has been working since July 1st).
  • 修复了进入任务时发生的崩溃和故障。
  • Fixed instances of players becoming stuck in the hellpod loading screen.
  • 修复了更改设置后发生的崩溃（这次应该真的修复了，上次修复没有成功，我们已经将负责的工兵送往超级地球再教育营）。

🧠 Known Issues

  • 目前游戏内通过好友代码发送好友申请无法使用
  • 玩家可能无法被加入或邀请至游戏
  • 添加到近期玩家列表中的玩家将出现在列表中间
  • 玩家可能会遇到勋章和超级货币发放延迟
  • 流血致死的敌人不会推进个人指令和歼灭任务
  • 已部署的地雷有时可能会变得不可见（但仍然有效）
  • 电弧武器有时表现不一致，有时会哑火
  • 大多数武器在瞄准时射击点低于准星
  • 战略配备激光束可能会附着在敌人身上，但会部署到原始位置
  • 手推车站船模块不会减少Shield Generator Pack的冷却时间
  • 吐酸泰坦有时头部不会受到伤害
  • 加入进行中的游戏时玩家可能会卡在武装配置界面
  • 加入进行中的游戏的玩家可能无法使用增援
  • 每次保卫任务结束时行星解放战役进度达到100%
  • 升起超级地球旗帜目标不显示进度条
  • 职业标签页中的任务计数在每次重启游戏后重置为零
  • 部分武器的描述已过时，无法反映其当前设计
  • Personal orders may not display correctly. (Kill 5!)

补丁 01.000.403

🌍 Overview

对于本次补丁，我们对以下领域进行了改进和更改：

  • Crash fix related to the FAF-14 Spear
  • 常规修复

General

  • 日语语音现已在PS5全球可用（PC平台同样可用）。

🔧 Fixes

Crashes

  • Fix for crash happening when players with unique hellpod patterns leave during hellpod launch cutscenes
  • Crash fix while aiming with the FAF-14 Spear

  • 修复了选择繁体中文时部分字符显示"?"的乱码问题
  • Fix for Plasma Punisher being unable to shoot out of the SH-32 Shield Generator Pack and the FX-12 Shield Generator
  • Fixed so the Quasar Cannon has the correct change to its heat when on hot and cold planets
  • Fixed issue where Spore Spewer would appear purple on certain planets
  • 修复了在某些行星任务中粉色问号出现的问题
  • Fixed Peak Physique armor passive not properly affecting weapon ergonomics
  • 修复了玩家因不活跃被踢出后重新连接时可用行动被重置的问题

1.000.402 was a hotfix update released for Helldivers 2.

Contents

  • 1 补丁 01.000.402

补丁 01.000.402

🌍 Overview

对于本次补丁，我们对以下领域进行了改进和更改：

  • 生活质量改进
  • 崩溃修复
  • 常规漏洞修复

🔧 Fixes

Crashes

  • 修复了更改设置时发生的各种崩溃。
  • 修复了切换语言时崩溃或字体纹理损坏的问题。
  • 修复了退出任务后发生的崩溃。
  • Fixed a crash that occurs when opening the social menu with more than 100 friends. As a result we have also limited the friends list visibility to 100. You will remain friends with anyone over 100, but you may not be able to see them if they are offline.
  • 修复了与大量已屏蔽玩家和/或好友请求相关的社交菜单崩溃。
  • 修复了更改全屏模式后最小化时发生的崩溃。
  • 修复了拾取装备时可能发生的罕见崩溃。
  • 修复了主机迁移后，客户端与处于等待状态的终端交互时发生的崩溃。
  • 修复了与雷区相关的崩溃问题。

Misc Fixes

  • 修复了闪避和匍匐相关的问题。
  • Fixed not being able to stand up while wielding the ballistic shield.
  • Fixed the Recoilless reload speed.
  • 修复了用户在主机端举报玩家时无法填写描述的问题。
  • 修复了在战争债券中快速滚动目录时载具预览不会消失的问题。
  • Fixed Spear not targeting several entities (spawners, compound objects, etc).
  • 哨兵炮现在具有更高的摧毁数值，因此大多数爆炸无论伤害高低都不会立即将其摧毁。
  • 修复了因不活跃被踢时行动进度会丢失的漏洞。
  • 移除好友"和"屏蔽玩家"按钮现在需要长按确认，而非单击。
  • 修复了死亡时会尝试进入ADS的漏洞。
  • 修复了手持榴弹时收到交互表情会导致软锁定的问题。
  • 修复了玩家在不同姿态下进行ADS时，投射物与准星不一致的问题。
  • 修复了在他人的舰船上时生涯标签页中玩家模型损坏的问题。
  • Adjudicator: fixed incorrect recoil values.
  • 修复了最后与其交互的客户端玩家离开主机舰船后，军械库终端会失去功能的问题。
  • Fixed missing localization for flying patrols operation modifiers.
  • Fixed issue where throwing knives could be left floating in the air.
  • 支持游戏安装文件夹路径中使用非拉丁字体。
  • 直接从战争债券装备时，载具皮肤现在会应用到所有载具变体。
  • 修复了绝地潜兵乘坐战斗步行机时，旗帜目标未能正确追踪其位置的问题。
  • Fixed missing description for the PH-202 Twigsnapper helmet.
  • Fixed the issue where the shuttle would clip through Bile Titans and terrain during landing sequences.
  • 提高了PS5在CPU受限时的性能。
  • Fixes FX remaining when destroying Spore Spewer.
  • Ensure stim vfx remains on screen for the entire duration of the stim effect when med-kit bonus is present.
  • 修复了表情接收方玩家在表情动画期间能够使用武器的问题。
  • Hellbombs now get called down facing the player, rather than away from the player.

🧠 Known Issues

这些问题要么是由本次补丁引入的且正在修复中，要么来自之前的版本且尚未修复。

  • 目前通过游戏内好友代码发送好友申请不起作用。
  • 玩家可能无法被加入或邀请进入游戏。
  • 被添加到"最近玩家"列表中的玩家将出现在列表中间。
  • 玩家可能会遇到勋章和超级货币发放的延迟。
  • 在因AFK被踢后重新连接时，可用行动会再次生成。
  • 流血死亡的敌人不会推进个人指令和歼灭任务。
  • 电弧武器有时表现不一致，有时会哑火。
  • 大多数武器在瞄准时射击位置低于准星。
  • Plasma Punisher无法从shield generators中射击。
  • 战略配备光束可能会附着在敌人身上，但会部署到原始位置。
  • 手推车"舰船模块不会减少Shield Generator Pack的冷却时间。
  • 吐酸泰坦有时头部不会受到伤害。
  • 强袭虫的臀部不会受到爆炸伤害。
  • 玩家加入进行中的游戏时可能会卡在武装配置中。
  • 增援可能对加入进行中的游戏的玩家不可用。
  • 每个防御任务结束时，星球解放度达到100%。
  • 举起超级地球旗帜"目标不显示进度条。
  • 职业标签页中的任务计数在每次重启游戏后会被重置为零。
  • 部分武器的描述已经过时，未能反映其当前设计。

1.000.400 was a major update released for Helldivers 2

Contents

  • 1 补丁 01.000.400

补丁 01.000.400

🌍 Overview

对于本次补丁，一些主要关注领域是

  • 银河战争中显示补给线和攻击起源。
  • 战略配备、武器、行星和敌人的平衡更新。
  • 各种崩溃修复、稳定性改进和其他更新。
  • 仅邀请大厅创建。
    • The right most option in the Lobby settings. Currently only localized in English. Additional languages coming in the next patch

⚖️ Balancing

Goal with stratagem balance changes this patch:

With these balance changes we wanted to buff up some of the weaker stratagems to make them more viable and add more possibility for variety in the loadouts. We also changed a few to make them more consistent, but the goal was to keep a similar or higher power level. We are looking into the stratagems more to see if there are any other stratagems that might need some buffs or changes to make them more viable. We also want to be better at explaining what our goals are with the changes, please see the linked blog post for more information.

A/MLS-4X Rocket Sentry

  • 降低了散布
  • 优先锁定更大目标
  • 将目标距离从75提升至100米
  • 每次齐射的火箭数量从2减少到1（以获得更好的弹药经济）
  • 将爆炸半径从1米提升至4米
  • Decreased explosion armor penetration (Explosion can no longer damage heavy armored enemies. The projectile still has enough AP to damage heavily armored targets.)
  • 将投射伤害从200提升至300

A/MG-43 Machine gun sentry

  • 将冷却时间从180秒降低至120秒。

A/MG-43 Machine gun Sentry, A/G-16 Gatling Sentry, A/MLS-4X Rocket Sentry, A/AC-8 Autocannon Sentry, A/M-12 Mortar Sentry, A/M-23 EMS Mortar Sentry:

  • 将耐久度*从0%提升至80%

E/MG-101 HMG Emplacement

  • 将旋转速度提升100%

MD-6 Anti-Personnel Minefield

  • 将爆炸伤害从250提升至350

MD-I4 Incendiary Mines

  • 将爆炸伤害从150提升至210

Orbital Gatling

  • 开火速率提高25%
  • 将每轮齐射弹药数从30提升至60
  • 装甲穿透攻击已增加（可以伤害重型装甲敌人）
  • 将冷却时间从80秒降低至70秒

Orbital Precision Strike

  • 将冷却时间从100秒降低至90秒
  • 将生成/呼叫时间从4秒降低至2秒

Orbital Airburst Strike

  • 将冷却时间从120秒降低至100秒

Eagle 110mm Rocket Pods

While these changes may look like a straight up nerf, that is not the intention. Please see the blogpost for more information.

  • 改进了锁定目标
  • 增强了投射的穿透攻击（现在对重装甲敌人造成100%伤害，而非50%）
  • 投射伤害从600降低至250（作为对改进锁定目标和增强穿透攻击所带来额外伤害的补偿。）
  • 降低了爆炸的穿透攻击（爆炸不再能伤害重装甲敌人）

Eagle Strafing Run

  • 使用次数从3增加到4
  • 装甲穿透攻击已增加，现在可以伤害重型装甲敌人。

GL-21 Grenade Launcher

  • 将爆炸伤害从350提升至400

MG-206 Heavy Machine Gun

  • 将投射伤害从100提升至150
  • 对耐久身体部位的投射伤害从23%增加到33%
  • 将射速从450/750/900降低至450/600/750
  • 将装填时间从7秒降低至5.5秒
  • 提高了硬直强度

MG-43 Machine Gun

  • 将装填时间从4秒降低至3.5秒
  • 将弹匣最大数量从3提升至4

MG-43 Machine Gun, A/MG-43 Machine Gun Sentry, A/G-16 Gatling Sentry and EXO-45 Patriot Exosuits Gatling

  • 将投射伤害从80提升至90
  • 对耐久身体部位的投射伤害从7.5%增加到25%

AR-23 Liberator, M-105 Stalwart and AX/AR-23 “Guard dog”

  • 对耐久身体部位的投射伤害从10%增加到23%

AR-23C Liberator Concussive

  • 对耐久身体部位的投射伤害从23%增加到35%

BR-14 Adjudicator

  • 将弹匣容量从25提升至30
  • 对耐久身体部位的投射伤害从10%增加到20%

AR-61 Tenderizer

  • 将投射伤害从60提升至95
  • 对耐久身体部位的投射伤害从10%增加到17%
  • 将弹药容量从35降低至30
  • 将弹匣数量从10降低至8
  • 提高了硬直强度

PLAS-101 Purifier

  • 投射的装甲穿透攻击已增加至与爆炸相同
  • 降低了爆炸伤害衰减

CB-9 Explosive Crossbow

  • 爆炸的装甲穿透攻击已增加至与投射相同
  • 增强了爆破力量（可以摧毁虫穴和机器人构筑者建筑）
  • 添加了中型穿透攻击标签

R-36 Eruptor

  • 每次射击的全射伤害从420增加到570

R-63 Diligence

  • 对耐久*身体部位的投射伤害从10%增加到25%
  • 部分敌人拥有耐久的身体部位，这些部位受到投射伤害时只会承受一部分基础伤害

Other

  • Updated Recoil stance modifiers: We made changes to the recoil stance modifiers to make them more consistent and also reward being prone more. Almost all of them will improve the recoil and only a two have been made worse (and only by 10%).

查看博客文章以获取更详细的描述。

🎮 Gameplay

General

  • Removed operation modifier AA-Defenses: Reducing the stratagem slots by 1
    • We want to look over the operation modifiers in the future. Right now there are too few of them which become repetitive and the ones we have do not create variety or promote different playstyles. For now, we removed this one because it only encourages the players to bring the best stratagems and does not promote variety.
  • Disabled the Retrieve Essential Personnel defend event mission for the time being
    • 这是为了让该任务得到应有的关注和打磨，因为它目前被认为不够有趣，表现也未达到我们的预期。
  • 超级样本
    • Super samples now spawn on difficulty 6. The reason for this change is that we feel that their existence only on difficulty 7+ forced some players to play the game on a harder difficulty than they wanted to comfortably play on. We do however still want a gating of them but a less punishing one.
  • The SEAF Artillery stratagem is no longer blocked by stratagem jammers or Ion Storms, and is available after the mission timer ends and the destroyer leaves close orbit.
  • Enemies in melee range of the gates in the Evacuate High-Value Assets mission will now attack it more consistently.
  • 新增了从游戏内菜单和任务加载界面进行聊天的功能。
  • 更新了部分第一人称准星以提高可读性。

Social

  • 现已支持仅邀请大厅

Armors

  • 新增装甲被动：健壮体格（+50%近战伤害，+30%武器人体工学性能）

Planets & Hazards

  • Spike Plant
  • 出现在某些行星上的尖刺植物已重做。
  • 被植物爆炸或尖刺击中时不再造成流血或耐力消耗。
  • 现在会"爆裂"三次，向四周发射尖刺，造成更高的伤害。
  • Fire Tornados
    • 火焰龙卷风的行为已更改，它们不再会主动回应玩家的移动，而是会更随机地移动。
    • While a fire tornado storm takes place, enemy vision is reduced. Player vision is unaffected.
    • Fire tornados being more random should result in more variance in situations players find themselves in. Tornados are significantly less likely to pile up and overlap on extraction points or objectives, and will generally be a bit easier to deal with.
  • Tremors
    • 地震的生成已调整为略微更加随机。
    • 地震的震中大小和影响范围已增加。
    • 这些改动应该会导致更多远离玩家的敌人被眩晕的情况，同时减少玩家身边持续发生震颤的频率。
  • 视野
    • A lot of planets have had their fog amounts tweaked to be a bit less harsh and dense, to provide less fatigue from constantly fighting on planets with bad visibility. We still intend there to be foggy planets with worse visibility, but the balance was a bit off.
    • Desert planets such as Erata Prime, Chort Bay, Hellmire, and similar.
    • Highlands planets such as Varylia 5, Matar Bay, Oshaune, and similar.
    • 人造光源的强度已全面重新平衡和降低，以修复光源完全致盲玩家的情况。
  • Unexploded Hellbomb
    • The unexploded malfunctioning hellbombs that can sometimes be found on planets will now explode immediately if hit with strong explosions or heavy weaponry. They will still have the same delay if hit by small arms fire or weaker attacks.
  • 植被
    • Vegetation that’s large enough to slow the player now has an extra function. When inside the vegetation helldivers will be harder to detect, reducing their detection range by enemies. This effect stacks with other detection reducing effects such as nighttime, being crouched or prone, or things such as the scout armor passive.
  • Ion Storms
    • 为离子风暴添加了额外VFX。

Enemies

  • 腐蚀酸效果
    • The acid effect applied by hunters, bug mines, etc. now allows you to sprint while under the effect and slows you by 30% instead of 50%. Duration has been increased from 3 to 4 seconds. These changes are intended to make it less punishing for players to be slowed while fighting the Terminids, This allows us to use it in more places without making the experience very punishing, for example the Bile Spewers.
  • 装甲敌人平衡性调整
  • We have toned down the amount of heavily armored enemies like Bile Titans, Chargers on higher difficulties and instead spawn more hordes of smaller enemies, the difference should be quite noticeable and the amount should be at least 30% less than before during bug breaches. We have also toned down slightly how many Hulks that spawn for the Automatons. Our intent is to ease up on the demand of anti-tank weapons and by having more of the other enemies give a better incentive for the group to bring stratagems and weapons that take care of hordes.

Patrols

  • 巡逻队生成现在恢复到补丁01.000.300之前的工作方式，并进行了一些微调，以便当你远离有敌人存在的重要地点时，关卡不会显得过于空旷。

Stunning

  • Medium and large sized enemies now don't get stunned as easily. This will not affect the stratagems that stun, and will mostly just affect how easily the Pummeler can stun larger enemies.

🐜 Terminids

  • Bile Spewers & Nursing Spewers
    • 喷涌虫失去腿部后现在会被减速。
    • 喷涌虫呕吐物现在施加腐蚀酸效果。
    • Spewer puke now can only damage helldivers up to 4 times per second and the helldiver cannot take damage multiple times from the same projectile. This should reduce instances where you are instantly killed by it.
  • Bile Titan
    • 吐酸泰坦的头部对较弱的反坦克武器略微更不耐久。 It's not a large change, and will mostly matter for weapons like the railgun.
    • The Bile Titan’s puke can now only damage the helldiver 4 times per second and the helldiver cannot take damage multiple times from the same projectile. The damage is still very deadly so running through their puke is not recommended. Their puke now also has a bigger spread.
  • Charger Behemoth
    • The Charger Behemoth is now joining the battle on higher difficulties, it can now also take more damage than before. This enables us to spawn fewer chargers but still retain the difficulty.
  • 强袭虫
    • Will now only show bleedout effects from the body if the bleedout state has started. 它仍然可以在未开始流血至死状态的情况下显示来自嘴部的效果。

🤖 Automatons

  • Hulk Scorcher
  • The Hulk’s flamethrower now does less damage and cannot damage helldivers more than 4 times per second. In addition, the helldiver cannot be damaged multiple times by the same flame projectile. This should reduce instances where you are instantly killed by it.
  • Automaton Tanks
    • The Tank armor value on the front has been lowered to be the same as the non-vent sections on the rear of the tank. The intent was initially that it was supposed to be more armored in the front, but the visual language did not show that.
    • 坦克炮塔背面的通风口仍拥有与之前相同的装甲值，但现在将正确检测爆炸方向。
  • 机器人跳跃背包爆炸的伤害降低了50%，不过它仍然会使你着火。

🌍 Galactic War

Introducing Supply Lines & Origin of Attacks:

Supply lines were previously not shown on the Galactic War map to reduce clutter and improve readability. However based on the feedback from our community we have made an implementation showing them on the map. This solution tries to maintain the general readability while still exposing the system to players in game.
你现在还能看到攻击来自哪个行星，这可能让社区能够在源头阻止攻击。
我们还更新了分区和行星信息弹出窗口的视觉效果。

🔧 Fixes

  • The FAF-14 Spear targeting has been reworked and should now function much better. However it has lost the ability to target Automaton spawners, this is not intended and will be fixed in the future.
  • Intense Heat and Extreme Cold environmental modifiers will now affect the Quasar Cannon’s reload speed and will show correctly in the HUD.
    • 寒冷行星上的装填速度 -2.5秒
    • 炎热行星上的装填速度 +2.5秒
  • 在小地图上侦测敌人的雷达脉冲现在可见。
  • Most of Automatons weapons have now gotten tighter limits to how much the projectile they shoot can deviate from its weapons muzzle angle. What this means is that situations where devastators shoot sideways and similar should be fixed.
  • The weapons of the Exosuits are now allowed small adjustments in the angle they fire their projectiles versus their muzzle angle. This should make their weapons more accurate.
  • Ballistic shield now collides with grenades.
  • 解除屏蔽按钮不应再从社交菜单中消失。
  • 已屏蔽玩家无法再通过最近玩家列表加入屏蔽者的房间。
  • 修复了击杀敌人、参与任务和完成任务的数据无法正确显示在军械库中的错误。
  • 修复了玩家在关闭战略配备菜单后立即按下"快速榴弹"按钮可以投掷无限数量榴弹的问题。
    • 绝地潜兵现在在耗尽手榴弹时也会切换到最后使用的武器，修复了他们在战略配备菜单未打开时却拿着战略配备球的问题。
  • 修复了多处文本重叠问题。
  • The burning effect applied to the player when a combat walker dies is now a normal burn. The intent is that you should be able to escape it alive. But you will be on fire so hit the ground!
  • The extraction shuttle can no longer take damage preventing extraction. New high grade materials directly from Super Earth R&D have been utilized.
  • 在PC上，你现在可以使用"WASD"键导航超级货币菜单
  • 修复了任务中样本数量显示不正确的问题
  • 关卡不再生成会阻止玩家推进的封锁区域。
  • 你的舰船舰桥不再笼罩在永恒的阴影中。
  • Reduced situations where blue stratagems would bounce when placed next to the detector tower.
  • 战争债券菜单现在会在缩略图中显示正确的表情和胜利姿势。
  • War Medals cap is now displayed in the UI.
  • 修复了绝地潜兵的装甲在其他玩家视角中可能显示为隐形的bug。
  • 优化了玩家举报界面。
  • 修复了绝地潜兵在靠近吐酸泰坦或移动工厂尸体时会被抛向空中的问题。
  • Fix for Factory Strider sometimes spawned an extra model after being destroyed.
  • 减少了绝地潜兵在某些星球上走入看似可通行的山谷时突然死亡的情况。
  • 修复了在雪地星球上玩家靠近大片水域时可能突然死亡的罕见问题。
  • 修复了鹈鹕-1号有时会在任何玩家登船后立即离开的问题。
  • 修复了绝地潜兵在投掷榴弹后可能卡在榴弹闲置状态的bug
  • Fixed Superior Packing Methodology not working for other peers.
  • 近期玩家列表现在将包含热加入的玩家。
  • 放宽了PC用户的断开连接政策。
  • 修复了重启时之前会话的玩家名称可能无法正确保存的问题。
  • 当鼠标悬停带有保卫事件的星球或攻击来源星球时，现在会显示保卫事件的攻击来源。
  • 为之前可读性较差的文本添加了轮廓。

Crash Fixes

  • 常规崩溃修复
  • 修复了对多个敌人施加伤口时可能发生的崩溃。
  • PlayStation独占：修复了在画质模式和性能模式之间切换时有时会导致游戏崩溃的问题。
  • Fix for a crash when a player leaves after all their railguns have exploded.
  • 修复了重新加入先前会话时可能发生的崩溃
  • 修复了尝试在ADS模式下投掷雪球时发生的崩溃
  • 修复了热加入时武装配置中止可能导致的崩溃
  • 修复了与瞄准武器时离开会话相关的罕见崩溃

🧠 Known Issues

这些问题要么是由本次补丁引入的且正在修复中，要么来自之前的版本且尚未修复。

  • 玩家可能无法被加入或邀请进入游戏。

  • 电弧武器有时表现不一致，有时会哑火。

  • Plasma Punisher无法从shield generators中射击。
  • 战略配备光束可能会附着在敌人身上，但会部署到原始位置。

  • 增援可能对加入进行中的游戏的玩家不可用。
  • 每个防御任务结束时，星球解放度达到100%。

  • 职业标签页中的任务计数在每次重启游戏后会被重置为零。

补丁 01.000.304

🌍 Overview

对于本次补丁，我们对以下领域进行了改进和更改：

  • 崩溃修复
  • 杂项修复

🔧 Fixes

崩溃

  • 修复了玩家热加入后主机离开时触发的崩溃问题。
  • 修复了装备界面中偶尔发生的崩溃问题。
  • 修复了进出舰船时可能发生的罕见崩溃问题。

杂项修复

  • 修复了主机离开时玩家卡在任务总结界面的问题。
  • 修复了未购买的超级货币在战争债券概览界面中不可见的问题（仅与日本发行版相关）。
  • 可选账户关联现在可在游戏内设置的账户部分中使用。
  • 修复了由于不同错误而显示"提供的Steam AppId无效或不允许"的问题。
  • 修复了教程中武器附件在某些情况下显示为紫色问号的问题。
  • Airburst proximity explosion is now triggered only by enemies & Helldivers.
  • The AR-61 Tenderizer now has the correct color scheme.

🧠 Known Issues

这些问题要么是由本次补丁引入的且正在修复中，要么来自之前的版本且尚未修复。

  • 玩家可能没有发送、接受或拒绝好友请求的选项。
  • 玩家可能没有屏蔽其他玩家的选项。

  • 玩家可能会遇到勋章和超级货币发放的延迟。

  • 长矛的瞄准不一致，难以锁定大型敌人。
  • 战略配备光束可能会附着在敌人身上，但会部署到原始位置。

  • "手推车"舰船模块不会减少护盾发生器背包的冷却时间。

  • 增援可能对某些加入进行中的游戏的玩家不可用。
  • 每个防御任务结束时，星球解放度达到100%。

1.000.302 was an update released for Helldivers 2

Contents

  • 1 补丁 01.000.302

补丁 01.000.302

🌍 Overview
对于本次补丁，我们对以下领域进行了改进和更改：

  • 一些武器和敌人平衡性调整
  • 崩溃修复
  • 社交菜单问题
  • 持续伤害修复
  • 瞄准镜错位修复
  • 常规修复与改进

⚖️ Balancing
主要、次要及辅助武器

  • R-9 Eruptor
    • 爆炸伤害增加40并移除了爆炸中的弹片
    • 这是为了避免玩家在爆炸周围巨大范围内随机一击击杀自己或队友的情况
  • 敌人
    • Increased Shrieker sight and hearing range slightly.
    • Increased Gunship hearing range slightly.

🔧 Fixes
Gameplay

  • We have fixed issues with the way Damage-over-time effects were being applied. This should fix issues where only the network session owner could apply them, and other cases where they would be applied inconsistently.
  • 装备盾牌背包时使用等离子惩罚者射击不再伤害绝地潜兵
  • 修复了某些武器瞄准镜在第一人称视角中未对齐的问题。
  • 使用刺激针时的声音在被打断时不再播放
  • Major orders with the “Kill task” now track score correctly. Previously it counted the entire squad’s kills once for each player, meaning it would multiply the score by the number of people on the mission; this is now amended.
  • 绝地潜兵不再能在"虫群防御任务"中降落在高岩石上
  • 绝地潜兵不再能在停用终结族控制系统任务中降落在虫柱顶部
  • 修复了如果绝地潜兵在准备就绪前离开会话，然后热加入活跃会话时，增援战略配备不存在的问题

Crashes

  • 修复了"停用终结族控制系统"任务中所有玩家死亡时可能发生的崩溃问题
  • 修复了游戏关闭时可能发生的崩溃问题
  • 修复了离开任务并重新加入时可能发生的崩溃问题
  • 修复了过场动画结束时可能发生的崩溃问题
  • 修复了潜入任务时可能发生的崩溃问题
  • 修复了PC上使用Alt+Tab时教程可能发生的崩溃问题
  • 修复了使用光束武器时可能发生的罕见崩溃问题
  • 修复了使用VPN时玩家启动时可能发生的罕见崩溃问题
  • 修复了如果玩家在战略配备菜单打开时打开文字聊天可能发生的软锁问题
  • 其他常规崩溃修复

Social Menu fixes

  • 通过好友代码添加好友的PC玩家不再显示为"未知"
  • 修复了菜单内重叠的页脚
  • Steam好友现在应该在社交菜单中可见，即使Steam隐私设置中的好友列表未设为公开
  • 最近玩家列表现在将包含热加入的玩家
  • 玩家现在可以解除屏蔽之前不在好友列表中的玩家
  • 修复了社交菜单中好友名称为空的问题
  • 大厅隐私模式文字在更改时立即更新
  • 超过26个字符的玩家名称现在应该在社交菜单中正确更新
  • 修复了非主机玩家可以无差别踢出其他玩家（包括主机）的问题

Other

  • 机器人工坊部分右侧的已购买总数不再显示7/8，尽管所有战略配备都已购买
  • 解决了登录时与Steam AppId相关错误的一些边缘情况

🧠 Known Issues
这些问题要么是由本次补丁引入的且正在修复中，要么来自之前的版本且尚未修复。

  • 玩家可能没有发送、接受或拒绝好友请求的选项。
  • 被屏蔽的玩家未被添加到屏蔽玩家列表中，也未被阻止加入游戏。
  • 增援可能对某些加入进行中的游戏的玩家不可用。
  • 绝地潜兵在被敌人包围时可能无法从蹲伏状态站起。
  • 如果玩家在任务期间更改文字语言，游戏可能会崩溃。
  • 玩家可能会遇到勋章和超级货币发放的延迟。
  • 流血死亡的敌人不会推进个人指令和歼灭任务。
  • 电弧武器有时表现不一致，有时会哑火。
  • 长矛的瞄准不一致，难以锁定大型敌人。
  • 战略配备光束可能会附着在敌人身上，但会部署到原始位置。
  • 爆炸不会打断你的肢体（除非你撞到岩石上）。
  • 机器人探测塔周围区域使蓝色战略配备（如地狱炸弹）在尝试靠近塔楼呼叫时反弹并被排斥。
  • 每个防御任务结束时，星球解放度达到100%。
  • 教程中的某些武器在某些情况下有缺失部件，显示为问号。

补丁 01.000.301

🌍 Overview 对于本次补丁，一些主要关注领域是

  • 性能改进
  • 崩溃修复

🔧 Fixes

  • 修复了任务结束界面期间可能发生的崩溃问题
  • Fix for crash which could occur when destroying automaton tanks.

🧠 Known Issues [Unchanged since patch 1.000.300]

这些问题要么是由本次补丁引入的且正在修复中，要么来自之前的版本且尚未修复。

  • 持续伤害效果可能仅在由主机施加时生效。 We expect to have this fixed in the next patch.

  • 如果玩家在任务期间更改文字语言，游戏可能会崩溃。
  • 涉及好友邀请和跨平台游戏的各种问题：
    • 当请求玩家在请求被接受前更改了用户名时，好友请求无法被接受。
    • 跨平台好友邀请可能不会出现在好友请求标签页中。

  • 某些武器（如反器材步枪）上的瞄准镜略微错位。
  • 电弧武器有时表现不一致，有时会哑火。
  • 长矛的瞄准不一致，难以锁定大型敌人。
  • 战略配备光束可能会附着在敌人身上，但会部署到原始位置。
  • 爆炸不会打断你的肢体（除非你撞到岩石上）。
  • Area around Automaton Detector Tower makes blue stratagems such as the Hellbomb bounce and be repelled when trying to call them down close to the tower.
  • 每个防御任务结束时，星球解放度达到100%。

1.000.300 was an update released for Helldivers 2

Contents

  • 1 补丁 01.000.300

补丁 01.000.300

🌍 Overview

本次更新包含

  • Balance changes to Weapons, Stratagems, and Enemies.
  • 常规修复与稳定性改进

⚖️ Balancing

General

  • Armors with armor rating above 100 now also reduce damage on headshots.
  • Victory poses will now only play for the extracted. (No stolen valor on my ship.)

Primary, Secondary, & Support Weapons

  • CB-9 Exploding Crossbow
    • 爆炸范围略小
    • 提高踉跄效果
    • 最大弹匣数量从12减少至8
    • Increased number of magazines received from resupply from 6 to 8
    • 人体工学略微降低
    • 枪口初速提高
  • LAS-99 Quasar Cannon
    • 充能时间增加5秒
  • BR-14 Adjudicator
    • 全自动现在是默认射击模式
    • 降低后坐力
    • 最大弹匣数量从6增加至8
    • 从补给获得的弹匣数量从6增加至8
    • 现在归入突击步枪类别
  • Laser Cannon
    • 略微提升伤害
    • 略微降低对大型体积身体的伤害
  • SG-8P Punisher Plasma
    • 最大弹匣数量从12减少至8
    • 从补给获得的弹匣数量从6增加至8
    • 提高了弹丸速度，但仍保持相似的射程
    • 降低爆炸伤害衰减
    • 现在归入能量武器类别
  • ARC-12 Blitzer
    • 每分钟射击次数从30增加至45
    • 现在归入能量武器类别
  • R-36 Eruptor
    • 最大弹匣数量从12减少至6
    • 爆炸伤害衰减略快
  • LAS-16 Sickle
    • 弹匣数量从6减少至3
  • Scythe
    • 伤害从300提升至350
    • 最大弹匣数量从6减少至4
  • Railgun
    • 在安全模式和非安全模式下均提高护甲穿透
    • 踉跄值略微降低
  • MG-101 Heavy Machine Gun
    • 启用第三人称准星
  • Diligence Counter Sniper
    • 伤害从128提升至140
    • 人体工学改善
  • Diligence
    • 伤害从112提升至125
  • P-19 Redeemer
    • 后坐力略微增加
  • Peacemaker
    • 伤害从60提升至75
  • Senator
    • 伤害从150提升至175
    • 空弹膛装填时增加了快速装弹器——显著加快了空弹时的装填速度
  • Dagger
    • 伤害从150提升至200
  • Liberator
    • 伤害从55提升至60
  • Liberator Concussive
    • 伤害从55提升至65
  • Dominator
    • 伤害从300降低至275
  • Guard Dog Rover
    • 伤害降低30%
  • Guard Dog
    • 伤害略微提升
  • Burning damage降低15%。

Stratagems

  • Machinegun Sentry
    • 提高生命值以匹配其他哨兵
  • Tesla Tower
    • 生命值增加33%
  • RL-77 Airburst Rocket Launcher
    • Airburst Rocket Launcher will no longer detonate when shot near stratagems (HMG turret, Sentries, Resupplies) and other Helldivers.
    • 减少接近半径

Enemies

已对以下内容进行平衡性调整：

  • Bile Spewer and Nursing Spewers movespeed slightly reduced
  • Hulks: Force required for them to stagger slightly increased
  • Hulk Scorcher direct flamethrower damage reduced by 20%
  • Devastator fire rate slightly increased (only the standard devastator)
  • Gunships sideways movement slightly increased
  • Scout strider Riders now less vulnerable to explosions
  • Fog Generators health and armor increased
  • Gunship spawners now have a much lower cap on how many gunships they can have active at the same time.

Enemy Patrols

  • Balancing adjustment to patrol spawning.
  • Patrol spawning has been increased when there are fewer than 4 players. The fewer the players the bigger the change. For 4 player missions there will be no change compared to before.The biggest noticeable change will be for solo players at higher difficulties.

🎮 Gameplay

  • Made minor level generation improvements to how we distribute locations throughout the mission map. This should improve variation in distance between objectives, and objectives will likely not spawn as far away from each other as often as before.
  • 在选项菜单的游戏玩法部分添加了设置，以禁用冲刺时的自动攀爬和翻越。
  • The Spread Democracy mission otherwise known as “raise the flag” can now be enjoyed on higher difficulties for maximum freedom spreading.
  • 准备就绪时，绝地潜兵现在会敬礼以确保最大限度的管理式民主准备状态。
  • Added ambience to the Tremor planetary hazard to underline the severity so Helldivers can react accordingly
  • Shots that ricochet from heavy armored enemies will now properly hit the Helldiver who fired them. Trigger discipline is highly recommended.

🔧 Fixes

  • 崩溃修复
    • 修复了主机放弃小队任务时可能发生的崩溃问题。
    • Fixed crash that could occur if a player tried to enter an occupied EXO-45 Patriot Suit.
    • 修复了任务结果界面期间或之后所有玩家可能发生的崩溃问题。
    • 修复了从EXO-45爱国者外骨骼装甲火箭发射器射击后可能发生的崩溃问题。
    • 修复了除使用不同护甲重新加入正在进行任务并获得增援的玩家外，所有玩家可能发生的崩溃问题。
  • Fixed Superior Packing Methodology ship module not working properly.
  • Fixed Blast Absorption ship module so that it correctly increases sentries’ resistance to explosions.
  • 修复了玩家无法导航至社交菜单中搜索结果的问题。
  • Fixed some issues where items equipped in a Warbond were not actually equipped.
  • 修复了一个允许过于急切的绝地潜兵过度使用手雷的漏洞。
  • 修复了轨道轰炸击杀未推进间接火力演习指令的问题。
  • 修复了允许叛徒通过在撤离穿梭机下方部署哨兵战略配备来试图破坏撤离穿梭机的问题。
  • Fixed issue where ion storms incorrectly prevented extraction beacon from deploying.
  • 修复了某些战略配备光束使用错误颜色编码的问题。
  • 修复了手柄左摇杆无法用于导航社交菜单的问题。
  • 修复了超宽显示器上各种用户界面元素被截断、偏离中心或过于靠近屏幕边缘的问题。
  • Fixed Anti-Materiel Rifle facing away from the Helldiver after deploying it.
  • 修复了玩家通过在特定时间取消反器材步枪装填来复制弹药的漏洞。
  • 修复了反器材步枪在取消装填后会消耗额外弹匣的漏洞。
  • 修复了如果无后坐力步枪在弹壳插入后但完成装填前取消装填，会从背包中消耗额外弹壳的漏洞。
  • 修复了镰刀和类星体加农炮无法穿透植被射击的问题。
  • 修复了浏览军械库时武器缩略图消失的多个问题。
  • Fixed issues where Automaton Gunships sometimes could not see the player.
  • Fixed incorrect collision being left over after destroying Automaton bunkers or detector towers with hellbombs.
  • 修复了地狱炸弹在某些任务中无法部署的问题
  • 修复了导致绝地潜兵着陆时在深水中溺水的某些问题。
  • Fixed issue where Hellpod Space Optimization made ammo go above capacity.
  • Fixed issue where Stalkers became very visible in fog
  • 地雷现在可以被标记，以便更好地与团队协调。
  • 接收好友请求现在会给玩家弹出提示。
  • 提高了教程和入门流程中显示的提示和暗示的可读性。
  • 总经验值现在在生涯标签页中可见。
  • 通过将菜单宽高比修复为16:9并添加控制抬头显示宽度的设置，增加了对超宽显示器的更好支持。
  • 绑定到小键盘的按键在重启后不再重置。
  • 修复了在PC上游玩时将耳机插入DualSense手柄时音频不一致的问题。
  • Playing Rock, Paper, Scissors in front of the ship no longer causes player to fall out into space.
  • APW-1 Anti-Material Rifle and MG-206 Heavy Machine Gun now trigger hitmarkers while scoped in.
  • Secondary weapon no longer remains in the Ballistic Shield ADS position after using a stim with the Ballistic Shield Backpack equipped.
  • "打开文字聊天"现在可以重新绑定。
  • 爆炸武器，如R-36喷发者、CB-9爆炸十字弓。 GP-31 Grenade Pistol no longer pulls players inward from the blast.
  • 禁用了教程期间的小队邀请，这会导致用户界面重叠。
  • 修复了军械库中主要和次要武器在角色模型上重叠的问题。
  • 修复了首次启动时用户界面元素在21:9宽高比显示器上被截断的问题。
  • 举报和屏蔽玩家现在在队伍菜单中可见。
  • Dead Scavengers now stop screaming for help if killed while calling in reinforcements.
  • Fixed Anti Air cannons showing up as "Stratagem Scramblers" in danger warnings.
    • Added reload stage for the Spear reload after the spent missile had been discarded.

🧠 Known Issues

这些问题要么是由本次补丁引入的且正在修复中，要么来自之前的版本且尚未修复。

  • 持续伤害效果可能仅在由主机施加时生效。 We expect to have this fixed in the next patch.
  • Reinforcement may not be available for some players who join a game in progress.
  • 绝地潜兵在被敌人包围时可能无法从蹲伏状态站起。
  • 如果主机在死亡状态下离开并重新加入同一会话，游戏可能会崩溃。
  • 如果玩家在任务期间更改文字语言，游戏可能会崩溃。
  • 涉及好友邀请和跨平台游戏的各种问题：
    • 当请求玩家在请求被接受前更改了用户名时，好友请求无法被接受。
    • 跨平台好友邀请可能不会出现在好友请求标签页中。
    • 玩家无法移除通过好友代码添加的好友。
    • 玩家无法解除屏蔽之前不在好友列表中的玩家。
    • 玩家可能会遇到勋章和超级货币发放的延迟。
  • Enemies that bleed out do not progress Personal Orders and Eradicate missions.
  • 某些武器（如反器材步枪）上的瞄准镜略微错位。
  • 电弧武器有时表现不一致，有时会哑火。
  • 长矛的瞄准不一致，难以锁定大型敌人。
  • 战略配备光束可能会附着在敌人身上，但会部署到原始位置。
  • 爆炸不会打断你的肢体（除非你撞到岩石上）。
  • Area around Automaton Detector Tower makes blue stratagems such as the Hellbomb bounce and be repelled when trying to call them down close to the tower.
  • 每个防御任务结束时，星球解放度达到100%。

1.000.203 was an update released for Helldivers 2

Contents

  • 1 补丁 01.000.203

补丁 01.000.203

🌎 Overview

本次更新包含

  • Fixes to armor passive.
  • 多项稳定性改进


📍 Gameplay

  • CE-27 Ground Breaker armor now has the Engineer kit passive as previously advertised.


🔧 Fixes

崩溃修复

  • 修复了当其他玩家离开或加入游戏时，装备界面可能发生的多个崩溃问题。
  • Fixed multiple crashes that could occur after extraction when the mission results and rewards were shown.
  • Fixed crash which could occur when throwing back a grenade while wielding a heat-based weapon.
  • Fixed crash that could occur when hosting a play session migrates to another player.
  • 修复了如果生成太多平民可能发生的崩溃问题。
  • 修复了部署至任务时可能发生的各种其他崩溃问题。
  • 修复了游戏过程中可能发生的各种其他崩溃问题。


其他修复

  • Fixed an issue that resulted in different damage being dealt enemies between PC and console players.
  • 防御任务中的红盒不再可见。
  • Major orders should now properly display text.


🧠 Known Issues

这些问题要么是由本次补丁引入的且正在修复中，要么来自之前的版本且尚未修复。 This list is not exhaustive, and we are continuing to identify issues and create fixes. These are organized by feedback, reports, severity, etc.

  • Superior Packing Methodology ship module does not work properly.
  • 玩家可能无法导航至社交菜单中的搜索结果。
  • 涉及好友邀请和跨平台游戏的各种问题：
    • 玩家名称可能在其他玩家的好友列表中显示为空白。
    • 当请求玩家在请求被接受前更改了用户名时，好友请求无法被接受。
    • 跨平台好友邀请可能不会出现在好友请求标签页中。
    • 玩家无法移除通过好友代码添加的好友。
    • 玩家无法解除屏蔽之前不在好友列表中的玩家。
  • Damage-over-time effects may only apply when dealt by the host.
  • Players may experience delays in Medals and Super Credits payouts.
  • Enemies that bleed out do not progress Personal Orders and Eradicate missions.
  • Certain weapons like Sickle cannot shoot through foliage.
  • Scopes on some weapons such as the Anti-Materiel Rifle are slightly misaligned.
  • 电弧武器有时表现不一致，有时会哑火。
  • Spear’s targeting is inconsistent, making it hard to lock-on to larger enemies.
  • Stratagem beam might attach itself to an enemy but it will deploy to its original location.
  • Explosions do not break your limbs (except for when you fly into a rock).
  • Area around Automaton Detector Tower makes blue stratagems such as the hellbomb bounce and be repelled when trying to call them down close to the tower.
  • Planet liberation reaches 100% at the end of every Defend mission.

1.000.202 was an update released for Helldivers 2

Contents

  • 1 补丁 01.000.202

补丁 01.000.202

🌎 Overview

本次更新包含

  • 稳定性修复

📍 Gameplay

  • We have updated the stats UI for weapons to take into account any explosive damage done by them. This is to give weapons that do damage with explosive projectiles a more fair representation in the UI. Most notably affected is the PLAS-1 Scorcher.

🔧 Fixes

  • Fixed some crashes that occurred when deploying to mission.
  • 修复了撤离期间和撤离后发生的一些崩溃问题。
  • Fixed crashes that could occur if the squad deployed a large amount of support weapons.
  • 修复了游戏过程中可能发生的各种崩溃问题。
  • 修复了使用热能武器时可能发生的崩溃问题。
  • Fixed crashes which could occur if a player died while using the jetpack.
  • Fixed crash which could occur when large volumes of enemies were present.
  • 修复了玩家拾取雪球时可能发生的崩溃问题。
  • Fixed crash which could occur when completing an objective.
  • 修复了浏览社交菜单时可能发生的卡死问题。
  • Picking up Medals and Super Credits will no longer lock the player in place.

🧠 Known Issues

这些问题要么是由本次补丁引入的且正在修复中，要么来自之前的版本且尚未修复。 This list is not exhaustive, and we are continuing to identify issues and create fixes. These are organized by feedback, reports, severity, etc.

  • 涉及好友邀请和跨平台游戏的各种问题：
    • 玩家名称可能在其他玩家的好友列表中显示为空白。
    • 当请求玩家在请求被接受前更改了用户名时，好友请求无法被接受。
    • 跨平台好友邀请可能不会出现在好友请求标签页中。
    • 玩家无法移除通过好友代码添加的好友。
    • 玩家无法解除屏蔽之前不在好友列表中的玩家。
  • 持续伤害效果可能仅在由主机施加时生效。
  • 玩家可能会遇到勋章和超级货币发放的延迟。
  • Enemies that bleed out do not progress Personal Orders and Eradicate missions.
  • Certain weapons like the Sickle cannot shoot through foliage.
  • Scopes on some weapons such as the Anti-Materiel Rifle are slightly misaligned.
  • 电弧武器有时表现不一致，有时会哑火。
  • Spear’s targeting is inconsistent, making it hard to lock-on to larger enemies.
  • Stratagem beam might attach itself to an enemy but it will deploy to its original location.
  • 爆炸不会打断你的肢体（除非你撞到岩石上）。
  • Area around Automaton Detector Tower makes blue stratagems such as the hellbomb bounce and be repelled when trying to call them down close to the tower.
  • 每个防御任务结束时，星球解放度达到100%。

1.000.200 was an update released for Helldivers 2

Contents

  • 1 补丁 01.000.200
  • 2 未记录变更
    • 2.1 敌人

补丁 01.000.200

🌎 概览

本次更新包含

  • Balance changes to missions, stratagems, weapons, enemies and Helldivers.
  • 一般修复和稳定性改进。

📍 游戏玩法

Planetary Hazard additions

  • Blizzards
  • Sandstorms

Maximum level cap raised to 150

⚖️ 平衡性调整 Missions

  • Retrieve Essential Personnel
    • 将敌人生成点移至离目标更远的位置，让玩家有更公平的机会防守该地点。
    • There are fewer civilians required to complete the mission on higher difficulties.
  • Destroy Command Bunkers
    • 现在拥有更多目标地点，该任务之前相比其他任务过于简单。
    • 现在可以在难度5及以上的行动中出现。
  • Halved the negative effect of operation modifiers that increase stratagem cooldowns or call in times.


Primary, Secondary, & Support Weapons

  • Arc Thrower: fixed charging inconsistencies; it will now always take 1s to charge a shot.
  • 电弧发射器：射程从50米减少至35米。
  • 电弧发射器：提高踉跄值。
  • Guard Dog: now restores full ammo from supply boxes.
  • Anti-Materiel Rifle: damage increased by 30%.
  • Breaker Incendiary: damage per bullet increased from 15 per bullet to 20 per bullet.
  • 火焰每次伤害增加50%（来自所有来源）。
  • Liberator Penetrator: now has a full auto mode.
  • Dominator: increased damage from 200 to 300.
  • 主宰者：提高踉跄效果。
  • Diligence Counter Sniper: increased armor penetration from light to medium.
  • Slugger: reduced stagger.
  • 重击者：伤害从280降低至250。
  • 重击者：降低破坏力。
  • 重击者：修复了菜单中的护甲穿透标签。
  • Slugger, Liberator Concussive, Senator: fixed incorrect armor penetration tags in the menu.
  • Recoilless Rifle: increased the number of rockets you restore from supply boxes from 2 to 3.
  • Spear: increased the number of missiles you restore from supply boxes from 1 to 2.
  • Heavy Machine Gun: the highest fire rate mode reduced from 1200 rpm to a more moderate 950

Stratagems

  • Patriot Exosuit: rockets will now penetrate armor only on direct hit.

Enemies

  • 已对以下内容进行平衡性调整：
    • Chargers normal melee attack now does less damage against Exosuits.
    • Bile Spewer and Nursing Spewer do less damage with their puke.
    • The Bile Titan can no longer be stunned.
    • Shriekers no longer create bug breaches.
    • 尖啸虫在死亡状态下击中你现在造成的伤害显著降低。

Helldiver

  • 已对以下内容进行平衡性调整：
    • Heavy and medium armor protects better and you now take about 10% less damage than before while wearing heavy and about 5% less when wearing medium armor. Fortified commando and light armor is unchanged.

🔧 修复

  • 修复了PS5保存设置在重启游戏时重置的问题，导致装备和提示设置等重置。
  • Enemies now properly target Exosuits. Previously, many enemies effectively ignored Exosuits if a helldiver on foot was available for them to target.
  • 修复了外骨骼装甲可以在打开小地图时开火的问题。
  • 绝地潜兵和外骨骼装甲都有一个漏洞，使它们有时会多次受到爆炸伤害，导致机器人火箭等过于致命，现已修复。
  • Automaton enemy constellations that preferred to spawn more of certain Devastators types did not work and are now functioning as they should. This means that sometimes when playing against the Automatons you will face more Devastators instead of other enemy types.
  • We have improved the system that prevents hellpod steering close to large or important objects.
    • 我们解决了物体周围有效区域远大于预期的问题。
    • 我们减少了阻止地狱舱转向的物体数量。
    • ⚠️Note: This system is intended to prevent softlocks where players can drop on important interaction points, or drop into unintended places. We will continue to monitor the state of the system after the update to see if additional tweaks are necessary.
  • 修复了某些物体下方地面可被轰炸导致其漂浮的问题。
  • Ballistic shield changes:
    • 碰撞网格尺寸略微增大以提高容错性
    • 调整了盾牌姿势，使绝地潜兵暴露的部分更少
    • 修复了在第一人称使用盾牌时绝地潜兵部分身体变得脆弱的漏洞

🧠 已知问题

  • 这些问题要么是由本次补丁引入的且正在修复中，要么来自之前的版本且尚未修复。
  • 拾取雪球或扔回手雷时游戏可能会崩溃
  • 涉及好友邀请和跨平台游戏的各种问题：

Contents

  • 1 PATCH 1.000.103

PATCH 1.000.103

🌍 Overview
对于本次补丁，我们已实施：

  • Fixes to the EXO-45 Patriot exosuit, game stats, UI, and general stability.
  • 行星灾害和巡逻队生成的平衡性改进。

⚖️ Balancing

  • Balanced and adjusted spawn rates for the various planet hazards including tremors, meteor showers, volcanic activity, fire tornados, and ion storms. Hazards should now spawn less frequently during missions.
  • 流星雨除了降低生成率外，还进行了以下更改：
    • 减少了爆炸半径
    • 略微降低了流星伤害
    • 略微降低了流星速度
    • 流星颜色已稍作更改，以尝试使其更容易被发现。
  • 火山活动除了降低生成率外，还进行了以下更改：
    • 减少了爆炸半径
    • 略微降低了岩石速度
  • Lighting on Fenrir III has been adjusted to be a bit less bright to improve visibility during meteor showers.

🔧 Fixes

  • 减少了巡逻队在玩家身上生成的事件。
  • 外骨骼装甲在转向时发射导弹不再摧毁自己。
  • 外骨骼装甲即使受损也保留其近战功能。
  • 以下情况的崩溃修复
    • 在全屏模式下使用Alt+Tab切换时
    • 更改配音语言后
    • PS5启动问题
    • 在外骨骼装甲内使用刺激针同时手持手雷
    • 加入正在进行中的任务时
    • 在标题界面闲置时
  • Shots from arc-based weapons, such as 'Blitzer' shotgun and 'ARC-3 Arc Thrower' stratagem now count towards "Shots fired" and "Shots hit" stats.
  • Fixed network desync issue with downed Automaton dropships.
  • 修复了Elgato Stream Deck脚踏板支持问题。

🧠 Known Issues
这些问题要么是由本次补丁引入的且正在修复中，要么来自之前的版本且尚未修复。

  • 涉及好友邀请和跨平台游戏的各种问题：

  • 当主机语言设为乌克兰语时，在线功能无法正常工作。

1.000.102 was an update released for Helldivers 2

Contents

  • 1 PATCH 1.000.102

PATCH 1.000.102

🌍 Overview
Today's patch is dealing with the spawn rate of heavily armored Terminid enemies as well as the possible play against them. It also contains some fixes to UI elements and crash fixes.

⚖️ Balancing
Enemies:

  • The amount of heavily armored targets that spawn on higher difficulties, especially for Terminids, have been a big discussion point online and internally. The intent is for groups to have to bring some form of anti-tank capability but not to the degree previously needed.

To that end we have reduced the spawn rate of Chargers and Bile Titans on difficulties 7 and up. In addition we have reduced the risk of spawn spikes of Chargers and Bile Titans.
Please note that we have changed the distribution of enemy types, not reduced difficulty. Expect other enemy types to appear in greater numbers instead.

  • We are humbled by the community's ability to find things like Chargers “leg meta” in our game, however spending your heavy anti tank weapons on legs instead of the obvious weak point seems counter to expectation.

We are not changing anything regarding the Charger’s legs, we are however lowering the health of the Charger’s head. It should now be at a point where a well placed shot from a Recoilless Rifle or EAT-17 instantly kills a charger.
Together with the unfortunately undocumented change of last patch that increased the armor penetration ability of less well placed shots for EAT-17s and Recoilless Rifle shots, Chargers should now be easier to handle by well equipped groups.

🎮Gameplay

  • "Electronic Countermeasures" operation modifier, which had a chance of giving you a random stratagem instead of the one you input, has been removed in order to be reworked, and will be reintroduced in a future iteration. We found that this modifier wasn’t communicated clearly enough and overall caused more frustration than excitement with the way it was currently implemented. This change was made in 1.000.100 but was unintentionally omitted from the patch notes.

🔧 Fixes

  • 修复了多个抬头显示/用户界面元素上的缺失文字。
  • 修复了新闻视频中多个字幕/语音不匹配的问题。
  • Fixed various crashes that occurred mid-gameplay and when deploying to missions.

🧠 Known Issues
These are issues that were either introduced by this patch and are being worked on, or are from a previous version and have not yet been fixed.

  • Game crashes when attempting to use a stim while inside an Exosuit.
  • 引发大型爆炸时，天空中可能出现粉色伪影。
  • Automaton Dropship seemingly disappears and slides in after being shot down.
  • 电弧武器的射击可能不会计入任务后统计中的击杀数。
  • 玩家无法移除通过好友代码添加的好友。
  • 跨平台好友邀请可能不会出现在好友请求标签页中，跨平台玩家可能无法接受好友请求。
  • 通过PS5活动卡加入多人游戏会话时，玩家可能无法选择装备或返回舰船。
  • The Exosuit can destroy itself with rockets if it fires while turning.
  • 撤离期间，文字聊天框显示被电影式黑边遮挡。

📝 Other
Players can now see their unique account ID. When submitting tickets to support (https://arrowhead.zendesk.com), please include your account ID!

1.000.100 is an update released for Helldivers 2.

Contents

  • 1 MINOR PATCH 1.000.100

MINOR PATCH 1.000.100

📍 Major Updates
Planetary Hazards active

  • Many planets now have additional environmental challenges that will appear at random while you are deployed, from fire tornadoes to meteor showers and many more.

⚖️ Balancing
Eradicate Missions

  • Eradicate missions now require more kills and enemies spawn more often. The time to complete the mission was previously shorter than intended and should now take twice as long to complete.

Primary, Secondary, & Support Weapons

  • SG-225 Breaker - Decreased magazine capacity from 16 to 13, increased recoil from 30 to 55
  • SG-8 Punisher - Increased total ammo capacity from 40 to 60, increased stagger force, increased damage from 40 to 45 per bullet
  • SG-225SP Breaker Spray & Pray - Increased armor penetration, increased fire rate from 300 to 330, increased pellets from 12 to 16 per shot, decreased mag size from to 32 to 26
  • RS-422 Railgun - Decreased armor penetration in Safe Mode, decreased damage against durable enemy parts
  • FLAM-40 Flamethrower - Increased damage per second by 50%
  • LAS-98 Laser Cannon - Increased damage against durable enemy parts, increased armor penetration, improved ergonomics

Stratagems

  • Shield Generator Pack - Increased delay before recharging
  • Orbital 120MM HE Barrage - Increased duration of the bombardment, decreased spread
  • Orbital 380MM HE Barrage - Increased duration of the bombardment, decreased spread

🔧 Fixes

  • 修复了护甲等级数值未按预期减少伤害的问题。
  • 修复了某些虫洞（包括潜行者巢穴）过于难以摧毁的问题。
  • 修复了PS5上抗锯齿切换无效的问题。
  • 平衡了所有星球的光照，以解决游戏过暗的情况。
  • 提高了手电筒效果。
  • 提高了厄拉塔主星"沙雨"天气下的能见度。
  • 更新了教程材质和光照。
  • 改进了当"光照"图形设置设为"低"时某些材质看起来模糊的情况。
  • 修复了"提取E-710"主要目标中可能出现的计时问题。
  • Changed button interaction behavior for buttons in bunker POIs. Helldivers will now let go of the button after holding it for a few seconds.
  • 修复了某些大型物体在下方地面被炸毁后漂浮的问题。
  • 在洲际弹道导弹发射时站在旁边的绝地潜兵会被适当烤熟，并有可能发生非自发性燃烧。
  • 修复了布娃娃物理状态后雪球无法投掷的问题。
  • 修复了溺水后仍可使用手雷的问题。
  • 摄像机不再锁定在玩家自己的尸体上并阻挡观战模式。
  • 绝地潜兵现在会受到其他玩家产生的火焰、毒气等伤害。
  • 护甲在肢解时不再拉伸。

🧠 Known Issues
这些问题要么是由本次补丁引入的且正在修复中，要么来自之前的版本且尚未修复。

  • 从补给箱中拾取物品可能会导致角色长时间冻结在原地。
  • 快速连续从地堡和补给箱中拾取物品可能会导致其中一个物品无法拾取。
  • 玩家无法移除通过好友代码添加的好友。
  • 通过PS5活动卡加入多人游戏会话时，玩家可能无法选择装备或返回舰船。
  • 任务奖励倍率偶尔可能未被应用。
  • 某些任务中，任务目标HUD为客户端和主机显示不同数字。
  • 查看战争债券时始终显示默认护甲，无论玩家装备了什么护甲。
  • 撤离期间，文字聊天框显示被电影式黑边遮挡。
  • 抬头显示/用户界面中的某些文字缺失或显示不正确。
  • 当大量玩家同时尝试登录和/或游戏时，玩家可能会遇到问题：
    • 登录速率限制
    • 玩家在游戏过程中可能会断开连接
    • 当游戏与服务器交互时，可能会出现各种用户界面问题
    • 某些游戏在短时间内可能无法被其他玩家加入

  • 调整了撤离平民任务难度。
  • 改进了平台认证的处理方式，以避免启动时的黑屏等问题。
  • 改进了客户端与后端的通信，以获得更好的后端性能。
  • 为快速游戏实现了自动重试机制。
  • 为错误"10002038"添加了正确的登录错误信息。


🧠 Known Issues
这些问题要么是由本次补丁引入的且正在修复中，要么来自之前的版本且尚未修复。

  • 多人同时登录时的登录速率限制问题。
  • 玩家在游戏过程中可能会断开连接。
  • 奖励和其他进度可能会延迟或未被正确记录。
  • 当游戏与服务器交互时，可能会出现各种用户界面问题。
  • 拾取游戏中的某些物品可能会导致角色长时间冻结在原地。
  • 可能会出现其他未知行为。
  • 开场过场动画和舰船电视缺少日语配音。
  • 轻型/中型/重型护甲的护甲值目前未按预期生效。
  • PS5玩家可能仍无法使用快速游戏。

1.000.009 was an update released for Helldivers 2.

Contents

  • 1 🛠️ PATCH 1.000.009 (PC & PS5)

🛠️ PATCH 1.000.009 (PC & PS5)

Helldivers, we have prepared a patch for today. This one continues the focus on stability and matchmaking. We are separately working on the server issues that we’re facing at the moment. We know this is the highest urgency for most players and we treat them very seriously.

🔧 Fixes
以下问题已在本版本中修复：


稳定性/崩溃问题

  • 修复了与文本转语音相关的撤离过场动画期间的崩溃问题。
  • 修复了在连续进行多人任务后，在搜索摧毁任务撤离期间发生的崩溃问题。
  • 修复了在加入过场动画期间断开连接时发生的崩溃问题。
  • 修复了在瞄准模式下使用"SMG-37防卫者"射击时发生的崩溃问题。
  • 修复了与脚步效果表面数据相关的罕见崩溃问题。
  • 修复了与播放相同粒子效果相关的罕见崩溃问题。
  • 修复了与接受邀请相关的可能发生的崩溃问题。


匹配

  • 修复了导致我们向多人游戏服务发送无效数据的问题。
  • 改进了大厅排序，以增加连接成功率。


平衡性及其他修复

  • 防御事件难度已降低。
  • 修复了自杀、不可能和绝地潜兵难度任务过于简单的问题。
  • 虫群模式难度已提高。
  • 虫群模式计时器已增加至15分钟。
  • 更新了任务结束界面，以显示经验和申购点数倍率。
  • 可以携带多个相同战略配备进入任务的问题已得到解决。


🧠 Known Issues
以下列出的是正在处理的重要问题，这些问题要么是由本次补丁引入的，要么是来自之前版本但尚未修复的。

  • 高负载期间的后端问题已得到改善但仍然存在，问题包括：
  • 多人同时登录时的登录速率限制问题。
  • 玩家在游戏过程中可能会断开连接。
  • 奖励和其他进度可能会延迟或未被正确记录。
  • 当游戏与服务器交互时，可能会出现各种用户界面问题。
  • 拾取游戏中的某些物品可能会导致角色长时间冻结在原地。
  • 可能会出现其他未知行为。
  • 开场过场动画和舰船电视缺少日语配音。
  • 轻型/中型/重型护甲的护甲值目前未按预期生效。

1.000.008 was an update released for Helldivers 2.

Contents

  • 1 🛠️ PATCH 1.000.008 (PC & PS5) ⚙️

🛠️ PATCH 1.000.008 (PC & PS5) ⚙️

🌍 Overview
对于本次补丁，我们的主要关注领域是

  • 解决崩溃问题。
  • 改进匹配功能。
  • 优化我们的服务器
  • 防御事件更新


🔧 Fixes
以下问题已在此版本中修复。


匹配

  • Playfab优化 - Playfab环境已优化 - 所有大厅现在拥有正确的数据以运行更有效的匹配
  • 筛选优化——我们正在优化玩家搜索大厅时的筛选系统。


稳定性和崩溃问题

  • 我们修复了游戏中三个最严重的崩溃问题，包括粒子渲染器崩溃和布娃娃物理崩溃。
  • 修复了应用程序在笔记本电脑上优先使用集成显卡而非某些独立显卡的问题。


防御事件和重大指令。

  • 为了提高可读性，我们为重大指令防御事件添加了视觉进度指示器


🧠 Known Issues
这些问题要么是由本次补丁引入的且正在修复中，要么来自之前的版本且尚未修复。

  • 玩家在匹配时仍可能遇到一些不稳定情况。
  • Background music, Sound effects and JP audio does not play during the opening cutscene. Japanese VO is also missing from the Ship TV.

1.000.006 was an update released for Helldivers 2.

Contents

  • 1 🛠️ PATCH 1.000.006 (PC & PS5) ⚙️

🛠️ PATCH 1.000.006 (PC & PS5) ⚙️

🌍 Overview
对于本次补丁，我们专注于以下领域：

  • 提高了整体游戏稳定性
  • 为即将到来的服务器匹配改进准备了版本。
  • 解决连接和断开问题。


🔧 修复

  • 修复了应用程序在启动后不久关闭时的崩溃
  • 撤离过场动画期间游戏不再崩溃。
  • 好友过多的用户档案不再导致崩溃。
  • 修复了在撤离过场动画中使用文字转语音时的崩溃
  • 用户在加入过场动画期间断开连接时，游戏不再崩溃。
  • 任务摘要中的行动状态不再导致崩溃。
  • 修复了由断开连接的玩家残留视觉效果引起的崩溃。
  • 使用瞄准时游戏不再崩溃。
  • 修复了游戏数据打包中的不稳定性，该问题导致了补丁大小增加。
  • 改进了后端连接，减少了任务中断开连接的可能性。
  • 改进了匹配体验和成功率。

1.000.004 was an update released for Helldivers 2.

Contents

  • 1 🛠️ PATCH 1.000.004 (PC & PS5) ⚙️

🛠️ PATCH 1.000.004 (PC & PS5) ⚙️

开发者备注：

“

Hey everyone,

Okay, we have another build for PC. Since we launched, we've worked hard at solving some persistent crashes and bugs, especially the matchmaking issues you've likely seen and felt by now. In this new build, we've managed to improve the matchmaking success rate further, but unfortunately, it's not all the way there yet. The full solution might take additional days of work before it's fully functional. By the way, we have noticed that it works best if you join an active game by searching on planets rather than triggering Quickplay.

In this build, we've also addressed three other crashes. Please refer to the patch notes for more info on that. Additionally, Sagar had mentioned earlier that we hoped to send you a PlayStation patch today, but it's proving to take a little longer than expected.

Thank you for your patience. While we're getting this out as soon as we can, the thing that keeps us going is seeing all your awesome videos, stories, and reactions online. They're as good as Element-710 at fueling our brains over here!

— Micke


🌍 Overview
对于本次补丁，我们的主要关注领域是

  • 解决崩溃问题。
  • 改进匹配功能。


🔧 修复 以下问题已在此版本中修复。

  • 修复了按ESC打开菜单或按O打开社交标签时发生的崩溃。
  • 匹配后游戏不再崩溃。
  • 匹配的整体改进。
  • 修复了在首次下潜前与军械库互动后发生的崩溃。
  • 解决了装备MP-98骑士时崩溃至桌面的问题。


🧠 Known Issues
这些问题要么是由本次补丁引入的且正在修复中，要么来自之前的版本且尚未修复。

  • 玩家在匹配时仍可能遇到一些不稳定情况。 It may work better if you attempt to join an active lobby on a planet.
